title: Iran grants permission for some Iraqi oil tankers to pass through Hormuz
english: Iran has allowed specific Iraqi oil tankers to transit through the Strait of Hormuz following diplomatic discussions between the two nations. This move follows Baghdad's assurances that Iraqi territory will not be used for military aggression against any neighboring countries. Experts suggest this decision reflects Iran's preference to support Iraq while pressuring other regional states to limit U.S. military access.
amharic: ኢራን ከኢራቅ መንግስት ጋር ባደረገችው ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውይይት ተከትሎ፣ የተወሰኑ የኢራቅ የነዳጅ መርከቦች በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ በኩል እንዲያልፉ ፈቅዳለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው ባግዳድ የኢራቅ መሬት በጎረቤት ሀገራት ላይ ለሚፈጸም ጥቃት እንደማይውል ቃል ከገባች በኋላ ነው። የፖለቲካ ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት፣ ኢራን ይህን እርምጃ የወሰደችው ኢራቅን እንደ ወዳጅ ሀገር በመመልከት እና ሌሎች የባህረ ሰላጤ ሀገራት የአሜሪካን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ እንዲገድቡ ጫና ለመፍጠር ነው።
oromo: Iraan marii dipiloomaasii biyyoota lamaan gidduutti gaggeeffameen booda, dooniiwwan boba'aa Iraaq muraasni daandii galaana Hormuz akka qaxxaamuran hayyamteetti. Murtoon kun kan dhume, mootummaan Baagdaad lafti Iraaq biyyoota ollaa irratti miidhaa geessisuuf akka hin gargaarre waadaa erga galtee booda dha. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, Iraan tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatte Iraaqiin akka biyya michuutti ilaaluu fi biyyoota naannichaa kanneen buufata waraanaa Ameerikaaf hayyamanii jiran irratti dhiibbaa gochuufi.

title: Why is Israel building new illegal settlements?
english: The Israeli government is accelerating the construction of illegal housing units in the occupied West Bank to strengthen its territorial control. By expanding these settlements, officials aim to prevent the formation of a unified Palestinian state. Despite facing widespread international condemnation and threats of potential sanctions, the administration continues to move forward with its development plans.
amharic: የእስራኤል መንግስት በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ህገ-ወጥ የመኖሪያ ቤቶችን ግንባታ በማፋጠን ላይ ይገኛል። እነዚህን ሰፈሮች በማስፋፋት እስራኤል በግዛቱ ላይ ያላትን ቁጥጥር በማጠናከር አንድ ወጥ የሆነ የፍልስጤም መንግስት እንዳይመሰረት ለማድረግ እየሰራች ነው። ይህ አካሄድ ዓለም አቀፍ ተቃውሞዎች እና የማዕቀብ ማስፈራሪያዎች ቢገጥሙትም መንግስት ግን ግንባታውን ለማስቀጠል ቆርጧል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el to'annoo isaa naannoo Qaxxaamuraa Lixaa (West Bank) cimsachuuf jecha mana jireenyaa seeraan alaa ta'an ijaaruu ariifachiiseera. Ijaarsa kana babal'isuun, mootummaan Israa'el biyya Falasxiin tokko taate akka hin uumamne gufuu ta'uuf yaada. Ta'us, ijaarsi kun mormii idil-addunyaa fi xiyyeeffannoo maallaqaa (sanctions) kan kaase yoo ta'u, mootummaan Israa'el garuu karoora isaa itti fufuuf murteesseera.

title: More than 200,000 newly displaced in Sudan’s Kordofan region
english: The United Nations reports that ongoing conflict in Sudan’s Kordofan region has forced over 200,000 people to flee their homes since the end of last year. This violence is part of a broader civil war that began in 2023, which has already caused approximately 59,000 deaths. In total, the war has displaced 14 million people across the country, creating a massive humanitarian crisis.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እንደገለጸው በሱዳን ኮርዶፋን አካባቢ እየተባባሰ የመጣው ግጭት ባለፈው ዓመት መጨረሻ አንስቶ ከ200,000 በላይ ሰዎችን ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ አድርጓል። እ.ኤ.አ በ2023 የተቀሰቀሰው ይህ ጦርነት እስካሁን 59,000 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገ ሲሆን በአጠቃላይ 14 ሚሊዮን ዜጎችን ከመኖሪያቸው አፈናቅሏል። ይህም አገሪቱን ከፍተኛ የሆነ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ውስጥ እንድትገባ አድርጓታል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka ibsetti, gartuun waraanaa naannoo Kordofaanii keessatti dhalate irraa eegalee namoota 200,000 ol ta’an qe’ee isaanii irraa buqqiseera. Waraanni bara 2023 ka’e kun hanga ammaatti lubbuu namoota 59,000 ol kan galaafate yoo ta’u, waliigalatti namoota miiliyoon 14 ta’an mana isaanii irraa godaansiseera. Kunis biyyattii keessatti rakkoo namoomaa cimaa uumeera.

title: Israeli strikes kill two and injure others as Gaza attacks continue
english: Israeli military forces have intensified attacks across Gaza, resulting in the deaths of at least two Palestinians and multiple injuries over the last two days. Drone strikes and shelling in Deir el-Balah and Khan Younis have destroyed homes and damaged areas housing displaced families. Rescue teams continue to struggle with reaching victims as military operations and property demolitions persist in various parts of the territory.
amharic: ባለፉት ሁለት ቀናት በእስራኤል ኃይሎች በተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። በዴር አል-ባላህ እና በካን ዩኒስ የተካሄዱ የድሮን ጥቃቶች እና የመድፍ ተኩስ ቤቶችን በማውደም ለተፈናቃዮች መጠለያ የሆኑ ቦታዎችን ክፉኛ ጎድተዋል። ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች እና የህንፃዎች መፍረስ በተለያዩ የጋዛ ክፍሎች እየቀጠለ በመሆኑ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች ለተጎጂዎች ለመድረስ እየተቸገሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Guyyoota lamaan darban keessa humnoonni Israa'el gaazaatti haleellaa geggeessaniin namoonni lama ajjeefamanii kan biroo hedduun madaa'aniiru. Haleellaa xiyyaaraa fi meeshaa waraanaatiin magaalaawwan Deir el-Balah fi Khan Younis keessatti manni jireenyaa fi bakkeen namoonni buqqa'an keessa jiraatan miidhamaniiru. Hojiin waraanaa fi diiggiin manneenii bakka gara garaatti itti fufee waan jiruuf, gareen gargaarsaa namoota miidhaman bira gahuuf rakkachaa jiru.

title: Putin warns Ukraine has opened ‘Pandora’s box’, rejects peace proposals
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin has dismissed recent peace initiatives as unreasonable and unacceptable. He warned that Ukraine has invited severe consequences by attacking Russia’s financial systems. Furthermore, Putin signaled that Russia may retaliate by targeting Ukraine’s most critical economic sectors.
amharic: የሩሲያው ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን የቀረቡትን የሰላም ሃሳቦች ተቀባይነት እንደሌላቸው በመግለጽ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ዩክሬን የሩሲያን ኢኮኖሚ በማጥቃት ለከባድ አጸፋዊ እርምጃ የሚያጋልጥ መንገድ ከፍታለች ሲሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል። በተጨማሪም ፑቲን የዩክሬንን ቁልፍ የኢኮኖሚ ዘርፎች ኢላማ በማድረግ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ ፍንጭ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Raashiyaa Vlaadimir Puutin yaada nageenyaa dhihaate fudhatama kan hin qabne jechuun didaniiru. Yukireeniin dinagdee Raashiyaa irratti haleellaa raawwachuun ishee miidhaa cimaaf akka ishee saaxiltu akeekkachiisaniiru. Kana malees, Puutin Raashiyaan dinagdee Yukireen kanatti aanee jiru kan miidhu tarkaanfii fudhachuu akka dandeessu ibsaniiru.

title: Envoy says Israel did not give the US notice before strikes on Syrian base
english: US special envoy Tom Barrack recently accused Israel of launching military strikes on a Syrian base without providing prior warning to the United States. Israeli officials have rejected this claim, insisting that they shared relevant intelligence with American authorities before the operation took place. The incident highlights rising tensions, as Barrack criticized the move as an unnecessary escalation that could provoke Turkey, while Israel continues to assert its regional security interests.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ልዩ መልዕክተኛ ቶም ባራክ እስራኤል በሶሪያ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ ጥቃት ከመሰንዘሯ በፊት ለአሜሪካ ምንም አይነት ማስጠንቀቂያ እንዳልሰጠች ገልጸዋል። የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ግን ይህንን ክስ ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ ጥቃቱ ከመፈጸሙ በፊት አስፈላጊውን መረጃ ለአሜሪካ አካላት ማድረሳቸውን አጥብቀው ተናግረዋል። ይህ ክስተት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን አለመግባባት ያሳየ ሲሆን፣ ባራክ ጥቃቱን ለቱርክ የሚያስቆጣ እና አላስፈላጊ ውጥረት የሚፈጥር ተግባር ነው ሲሉ ነቅፈዋል።
oromo: Ergamaan addaa Ameerikaa Tom Barrack akka jedhutti, Israa'el buufata waraanaa Suuriyaa keessatti argamu irratti haleellaa raawwachuuf Ameerikaaf dursitee akeekkachiisa hin kennine. Bakka bu'oonni Israa'el himata kana gadi dhisuun, haleellicha dura odeeffannoo barbaachisaa ta'e qaamolee Ameerikaaf qoodneerra jechuun falman. Gochi kun walitti bu'iinsa dabalaa jiru kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, Barrack haleellaa kana Turkii kan aarsuu fi waldhibdee kan babal'isu tarkaanfii barbaachisaa hin taane jechuun balaaleffateera.

title: Canada to match US tariffs “dollar for dollar,” PM Carney says
english: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney announced that Canada will respond to new American tariffs by imposing equivalent duties on U.S. goods. This decision follows the collapse of trade negotiations between the two neighboring nations. The move signals a firm retaliatory stance in response to the U.S. trade policies.
amharic: የካናዳ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ እንደተናገሩት ካናዳ በአሜሪካ ላይ በምትጥለው አዲስ የታሪፍ ጫና ልክ የአጸፋ እርምጃ ለመውሰድ አቅዳለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል የተካሄደው የንግድ ድርድር ሳይሳካ በመቅረቱ ነው። ካናዳ በአሜሪካ የንግድ ፖሊሲ ላይ እኩል የሆነ የበቀል እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ዝግጁ መሆኗን ይህ ድርጊት ያሳያል።
oromo: Ministirri Muummee Kaanaadaa Maark Kaarnii akka ibsanitti, Kaanaadaan taarifii Ameerikaan ishee irratti buufteef deebii walfakkaataa kennuuf akka murteessite beeksisaniiru. Murteen kun kan dhufeyyuu erga mariin daldalaa biyyoota lamaan gidduutti ture fashale booda. Tarkaanfiin kun siyaasa daldalaa Ameerikaatiif deebii cimaa kennuu akka barbaadan kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Carney: Canada will enact retaliatory US tariffs starting September 8
english: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney announced that Canada will impose retaliatory tariffs on American goods beginning September 8. This decision follows the United States' recent move to place a 50 percent tax on nearly $20 billion worth of Canadian imports. Although both nations attempted to reach a trade agreement to prevent this, negotiations failed, leading Canada to take these measures to defend its economy.
amharic: የካናዳ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ እንደገለጹት፣ ካናዳ ከሴፕቴምበር 8 ጀምሮ በአሜሪካ ምርቶች ላይ የበቀል የንግድ ታሪፍ እንደምትጥል አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰነው አሜሪካ በ20 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመቱ የካናዳ ምርቶች ላይ የ50 በመቶ ታሪፍ መጣሏን ተከትሎ ነው። ሁለቱ አገራት የንግድ ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ቢሞክሩም፣ ድርድሩ ባለመሳካቱ ካናዳ ኢኮኖሚዋን ለመጠበቅ ይህን እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ተገዳለች።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeeraa Kaanaadaa Maark Kaarnii akka ibsanitti, Kaanaadaan eegalee Hagayya 8 irraa kaasee meeshaalee Ameerikaa irraa galan irratti gatii dabalataa (taarifa) akka keettu beeksisaniiru. Murteen kun kan dhufey Ameerikaan meeshaalee Kaanaadaa kan gatiin isaanii dolaara biliyoona 20 ga'u irratti gibira dhibbeentaa 50 erga keessee booda. Biyoonni lamaan waliigaltee daldalaa uumanii rakkoo kana hambisuuf yaalii godhanis, mariin isaanii waan hin milkoofneef, Kaanaadaan diinagdee ishee eeggachuuf tarkaanfii kana fudhachuu dirqamteetti.

title: Israel, Turkiye and the new regional reordering
english: Israeli fighter jets recently bombed a Syrian airbase under the false pretext of Turkish military activity, an action that drew widespread international condemnation. US intelligence officials confirmed they found no evidence for Israel’s claims, suggesting the strike was a politically motivated attempt by Benjamin Netanyahu to escalate regional tensions before his election. Turkey chose not to retaliate, instead urging the United States to take a more active role in curbing Israel’s aggressive actions.
amharic: የእስራኤል የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በቱርክ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ምክንያት በሚል ሰበብ በሶሪያ የሚገኝ የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸው በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል። የአሜሪካ የስለላ ተቋማት በእስራኤል በኩል የቀረበው የይገባኛል ጥያቄ መሠረተ ቢስ መሆኑን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ ጥቃቱ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ለምርጫ ዘመቻቸው ሲሉ የፈጠሩት የፖለቲካ ቀውስ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። ቱርክ ለዚህ ግጭት ወታደራዊ ምላሽ ከመስጠት ይልቅ አሜሪካ በእስራኤል ላይ ተጽዕኖ እንድታሳድር ጥሪ አቅርባለች።
oromo: Xiyyaarri waraana Israa’el sababa sobaan gocha waraana Turkii jechuun buufata xiyyaaraa Suuriyaa keessatti argamu haleeluun isaa mormii idil-addunyaa guddaa kaaseera. Qorannoon ogeeyyota basaasaa Ameerikaa akka agarsiisutti, himatni Israa’el dhugaa kan hin qabne ta’uu fi haleellaan kun mummicha ministeeraa Beniyaamin Neetaanyaahuuf faayidaa filannoo argamsiisuuf kan karoorfame ta’uu ibsameera. Turkii tarkaanfii waraanaatiin deebisuu mannaa, Ameerikaan gocha Israa’el kanneen to’achuuf qooda akka fudhatu gaafatteetti.

title: Swedish police identify 17-year-old girl as victim in school sword attack
english: Swedish authorities have confirmed that a 17-year-old girl was killed in a sword attack at a high school in Fagersta. An 18-year-old student at the same school has been arrested for the killing and the wounding of three other students. Investigators are currently examining whether the suspect was influenced by online extremist groups that glorify school violence.
amharic: የስዊድን ባለስልጣናት በፋገርስታ ሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት በተፈጸመ የሰይፍ ጥቃት የ17 ዓመቷ ሴት ልጅ መገደሏን አረጋግጠዋል። በተመሳሳይ ትምህርት ቤት የሚማር የ18 ዓመት ተማሪ ግድያውን በመፈጸም እና ሌሎች ሶስት ተማሪዎችን በማቁሰል ተጠርጥሮ በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። መርማሪዎች ተጠርጣሪው በትምህርት ቤት ውስጥ የሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶችን የሚያበረታቱ የኢንተርኔት ቡድኖች ተጽዕኖ ውስጥ ገብቶ እንደሆነ እያጣሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Siwiiden akka mirkaneessanitti, magaalaa Faagireestaatti mana barumsaa sadarkaa lammaffaa tokko keessatti weerara billaatiin dargaggeettiin umriin ishee waggaa 17 ta'e ajjeefamtee jirti. Barataan umriin isaa waggaa 18 mana barumsaa sanaa ta'e tokko ajjeechaa kana raawwachuu fi barattoota biroo sadii madaa'anirratti shakkamee qabameera. Qorattoonni weerarri kun qindoomina gareewwan interneetii kanneen jeequmsa mana barumsaa jajjabeessanirratti kan hirkate ta'uu isaa qorachaa jiru.

title: Israel has no intention of escalating tensions with Turkey, foreign minister says
english: Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar stated that his country does not want to increase tensions with Turkey, but firmly opposes any Turkish military presence in Syria. Israel is concerned that such a presence could mirror the regional influence of Iran and has justified recent airstrikes by citing intelligence about potential Turkish base construction. While both Syria and Turkey have denied these claims, Israel remains committed to preventing new military developments in the area.
amharic: የእስራኤል የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ጊዲዮን ሳር ሀገራቸው ከቱርክ ጋር ያለውን ውጥረት ለማባባስ እንደማትፈልግ ነገር ግን በሶሪያ ውስጥ የቱርክን ወታደራዊ መገኘት እንደማትቀበል አስታውቀዋል። እስራኤል የቱርክ መገኘት እንደ ኢራን ተጽዕኖ ሊፈጥር ይችላል በሚል ስጋት፣ በሶሪያ ላይ የአየር ጥቃቶችን ፈጽማለች። ምንም እንኳን ሶሪያ እና ቱርክ በሶሪያ ውስጥ ቋሚ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ የመመሥረት እቅድ እንደሌላቸው ቢክዱም፣ እስራኤል በክልሉ አዲስ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎችን ለመከላከል ቁርጠኛ መሆኗን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Israa'el Gidiyon Saar akka jedhanitti, biyyi isaanii Turkiin wajjin walitti bu'iinsa dabaluu kan hin barbaanne ta'us, buufata waraanaa Turkiin gara fuulduraatti Siiriyaa keessatti ijaaruu akka hin hayyamne ibsaniiru. Israa'el, dhiibbaan Turkiin Siiriyaa keessatti uumuu dandeessu kan Iiraan fakkaachuu danda'a sodaatti, kanaafis oduu buufata waraanaa ijaaruu irratti hundaa'uun miidhaa qilleensaa geessisteetti. Siiriyaafi Turkiin ijaarsa buufata waraanaa kanarratti haaluus, Israa'el naannichatti haala waraanaa jijjiiramu kamiyyuu akka hin hayyamne beeksisteetti.

title: US 'economic terrorism' will not break people's will: Iranian Vice President
english: Iranian First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref recently stated that US sanctions will not succeed in destabilizing his country. He argued that economic pressure actually strengthens the resolve of the Iranian people rather than weakening it. This reaction follows President Trump's decision to impose strict new financial penalties against Tehran.
amharic: የኢራን አንደኛ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ሞሀመድ ረዛ አሬፍ የአሜሪካ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦች ሀገራቸውን እንደማያዳክሙ ገለጹ። እንደ እርሳቸው ገለጻ፣ የኢኮኖሚ ጫናዎች የኢራን ህዝብን ከመጉዳት ይልቅ ይበልጥ እንዲጠነክሩ ያደርጋቸዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የተሰጠው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቴህራን ላይ አዲስ እና ከባድ ማዕቀቦችን መጣላቸውን ተከትሎ ነው።
oromo: Itti aanaa pirezidaantii Iraan Mohaammad Rezaa Aaref akka jedhanitti, sagantaan uggura dinagdee kan Ameerikaa biyya isaanii hin laaffisu. Akka isaanii, dhiibbaan dinagdee kun fedhii uummata Iraan dadhabsiisuu mannaa, caalaatti akka jabaatan taasisa. Ibsi kun kan kenname pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp Teheran irratti uggura dinagdee cimaa haaraa erga labsanii booda.

title: Israeli forces, settlers injure and arrest Palestinians across West Bank
english: Israeli forces and settlers conducted several violent operations throughout the West Bank, resulting in multiple injuries and arrests. Near Jerusalem and Jenin, five Palestinians were hospitalized following gunfire and physical attacks by settlers. Additionally, military forces entered a town near Hebron to raid homes and detain a young man.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና ሰፋሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች በፈጸሙት ጥቃት በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል እንዲሁም ታስረዋል። በኢየሩሳሌም እና በጀኒን አቅራቢያ በተፈጸሙ የተኩስ እና የሰፋሪዎች ጥቃቶች አምስት ሰዎች ሆስፒታል ገብተዋል። በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ ወታደሮቹ በሄብሮን አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ ከተማ በመግባት ቤቶችን በመበርበር አንድ ወጣት አሥረዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el fi qonnaan bultoonni iddoo gara garaa Qoqqoodama Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti tarkaanfii fudhataniin namoonni hedduun miidhaniiru akkasumas hidhamaniiru. Arraada Yerusaalem fi Jeniinitti dhukaasaa fi haleellaa qonnaan bultootaan namoonni shan hospitaala galeera. Kana malees, waraanni magaalaa Heebroon biratti argamtu tokko seenuudhaan manneen sakatta'anii dargaggeessa tokko hidhaniiru.

title: Blast on security forces’ bus near Damascus causes injuries
english: A bomb exploded on a vehicle transporting Syrian security personnel near Damascus on Saturday, resulting in multiple injuries. State media reported that officials are currently examining the scene to determine who was behind the attack. Images released from the site show significant damage to the bus, including shattered glass and a destroyed door.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ዕለት በሶሪያዋ ዳማስከስ አቅራቢያ የጸጥታ ኃይሎችን ሲያጓጉዝ በነበረ አውቶቡስ ላይ በደረሰ የቦምብ ፍንዳታ በርካታ ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። የመንግስት መገናኛ ብዙኃን እንደዘገቡት ባለስልጣናት ጥቃቱን ማን እንደፈጸመ ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ። ከቦታው የወጡ ምስሎች እንደሚያሳዩት አውቶቡሱ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe magaalaa guddoo Suuriyaa Damaasqoos biratti konkolaataa waraana fe'ee deemaa ture irratti boombii dhoo'een namoonni hedduun miidhamaniiru. Miidiyaan mootummaa akka gabaasetti, qaamni nageenyaa haleellaa kana eenyu akka raawwate adda baasuuf qorannoo eegaleera. Suuraan iddoo sanaa akka argisiisutti, konkolaataan sun gubatee fi cabee miidhaa hamaa irra ga'ee jira.

title: Armed men kidnap dozens in attacks on Nigerian villages
english: Armed assailants launched a series of attacks on multiple villages and a mosque in Nigeria's Niger State, resulting in the abduction of dozens of people. While authorities are currently conducting rescue operations, there are conflicting reports from residents regarding potential casualties and the exact number of individuals taken. The violence reportedly involved clashes between two armed groups, leaving local communities in a state of crisis.
amharic: በናይጄሪያ ናይጀር ግዛት የታጠቁ ቡድኖች በበርካታ መንደሮች እና በመስጊድ ላይ ባደረሱት ጥቃት በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ጠልፈዋል። ባለስልጣናት የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን እያከናወኑ ቢሆንም፣ በሟቾች ቁጥር እና በተጠለፉት ሰዎች ትክክለኛ መጠን ላይ ከነዋሪዎች የሚሰሙት መረጃዎች የተለያዩ ናቸው። ግጭቱ በሁለት የታጠቁ ቡድኖች መካከል የተከሰተ ሲሆን ይህም በአካባቢው ማህበረሰብ ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Naijeeriyaa keessatti gareen hidhattootaa gandoota fi masjiida tokko irratti haleellaa raawwatanin namoota hedduu butanii jiru. Mootummaan hojii furinsaatii fi ittisaa kan eegale yoo ta'u, lakkoofsa namoota butamanii fi miidhaa ga'e irratti odeeffannoon wal faallessu jira. Walitti bu'iinsi kun gidduu garee hidhattoota lamaa kan uumame yoo ta'u, ummanni naannichaa sodaa keessa akka jiraatu ta'eera.

title: Israel’s Chief Rabbi says Palestinians are not a people and have no rights
english: Israel's Chief Rabbi David Yosef has sparked controversy by claiming that Palestinians do not exist as a distinct people and possess no inherent rights. Speaking at a museum event, he further advocated for the destruction of Gaza and the establishment of Jewish settlements across both Gaza and the occupied West Bank. These remarks represent a hardline stance that asserts exclusive Jewish territorial claims over these disputed regions.
amharic: የእስራኤል ዋና ረቢ ዳዊት ዮሴፍ ፍልስጤማውያን እንደ ህዝብ እንደማይቆጠሩ እና ምንም አይነት መብት እንደሌላቸው በመግለጽ ከፍተኛ ትችት አስነስተዋል። በሙዚየም በተከናወነ ስነ-ስርዓት ላይ ባደረጉት ንግግር፣ ጋዛ መውደም እንዳለባት እና አይሁዳውያን በጋዛና በዌስት ባንክ ሰፈራ ሊመሰርቱ እንደሚገባ ተናግረዋል። ይህ አቋም በእነዚህ አካባቢዎች ላይ የእስራኤልን የበላይነት የሚደግፍና የፍልስጤማውያንን መብት የሚክድ ነው።
oromo: Rabbiin Olaanaa Israa'el Daawit Yoseef, warra Falasxiin akka sabaatti hin jiran jedhee fi mirga tokkollee akka hin qabne dubbachuun isaa mormii guddaa kaaseera. Ayyaana muuziyemii tokko irratti yeroo dubbatu, Gaazaarratti tarkaanfiin diiggaa akka fudhatamuufi lafa Gaazaafi Lixaa Baankii keessatti qubatanii jiraachuu akka qaban gaafateera. Haasaan kun laficharratti mirgi kan warra Yihuudii qofa akka ta'e kan ibsuufi mirga Falasxiinotaa kan guutummaatti tuffateedha.

title: Trump seeks to block the BBC’s attempt to subpoena Ivanka Trump, Trump Jr
english: President Donald Trump is asking a federal court to prevent the BBC from questioning his family members, including Ivanka Trump, Donald Trump Jr., and Jared Kushner. The subpoenas were requested by the BBC as part of a $10 billion defamation lawsuit filed by Trump over a documentary that allegedly edited his January 6th speech. Trump’s lawyers argue that the broadcaster is using the legal process to conduct an intrusive investigation rather than focusing on the specific editing dispute.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የቢቢሲ የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያ የቤተሰባቸውን አባላት፣ ኢቫንካ ትራምፕን፣ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጁኒየርን እና ጃሬድ ኩሽነርን እንዳይጠይቁ ለፌዴራል ፍርድ ቤት አቤቱታ አቅርበዋል። ቢቢሲ እነዚህን ሰዎች ለመጥራት የፈለገው ትራምፕ በዶክመንተሪ ፕሮግራም ላይ ባቀረቡት የ10 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የክብር መነካካት ክስ ምክንያት ነው። የትራምፕ ጠበቆች ቢቢሲው ክሱን ሰበብ በማድረግ ፍትህን ከመፈለግ ይልቅ ቤተሰባቸውን ለማሸማቀቅ እየሞከረ ነው ሲሉ ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Dooktar Doonaald Tiraamp, dhaabbanni miidiyaa BBC miseensota maatii isaa kanneen akka Ivaanka Tiraamp, Doonaald Tiraamp Juniyeer fi Jaared Kushnar akka hin gaafanneef mana murtii federaalaatti iyyatanii jiru. BBC'n namoota kana kan barbaade, Tiraamp sagantaa dookumentarii irratti miidhameera jechuun himata gatii biliyoona 10 irratti dhiyeesse hordofuudha. Abukaatonni Tiraamp, dhaabbanni miidiyaa kun himata dhihaate fayyadamee maatii isaa irratti qorannoo hin barbaachisne gaggeessuuf yaalaa jira jechuun himatu.

title: ‘Not a small issue’: People deported by US to Liberia face uncertain future
english: The United States recently deported a group of people to Liberia under a new agreement, even though many of those sent are not Liberian citizens. Families and lawyers are concerned because the government has not clearly defined the legal status of these individuals or their future rights. While officials claim they are welcomed as guests, critics argue the lack of transparency and consultation regarding this transfer raises serious human rights and sovereignty questions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግሥት አዲስ ስምምነትን ተከትሎ ሊቤሪያዊ ዜግነት የሌላቸውን ሰዎች ጨምሮ አንድ ቡድን ወደ ሊቤሪያ በግድ አስወጥቷል። የሊቤሪያ መንግሥት እነዚህ ሰዎች እንግዶች እንደሆኑ ቢገልጽም፣ ቤተሰቦች እና የሕግ ባለሙያዎች ግን ስለ ግለሰቦቹ የወደፊት ሕይወትና መብት ግልጽ መረጃ አለመኖሩን በመቃወም ተችተዋል። ይህ ድርጊት ያለ በቂ ምክክር እና ግልጽነት የተፈጸመ በመሆኑ፣ ሰብአዊ መብትን እና የሀገር ሉዓላዊነትን በተመለከተ ትልቅ ጥያቄ አስነስቷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa walii galtee haaraa irratti hundaa'uun, lammiilee Liiberiyaa hin taane dabalatee namoota garee tokko dirqiidhaan gara Liiberiyaatti ergeera. Mootummaan Liiberiyaa namoonni kunneen akka keessummaatti akka simataman ibsus, maatiinifi abbootiin seeraa waa'ee mirgaafi gara fuulduraa namoota kanaa irratti ibsi ifaan waan hin kennamneef yaaddoo qabu. Tarkaanfiin kun marii malee fi iftoomina dhabuun fudhatamuun isaa, mirga namoomaa fi bilisummaa biyyaalessaa irratti gaaffii cimaa kaasuu isaa ogeeyyoonni himu.

title: Seven killed, including two police officers, in UK ‘wrong-side’ car crash
english: A tragic head-on collision in the UK resulted in the deaths of seven people, including two police officers. The accident occurred during a police pursuit when a vehicle driving on the wrong side of the road struck a police car near Middlesbrough. Authorities are investigating the incident, which follows a concerning trend of dangerous driving linked to social media challenges in the region.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም በተከሰተ አሳዛኝ የመኪና አደጋ ሁለት የፖሊስ አባላትን ጨምሮ ሰባት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አደጋው የደረሰው ፖሊስ በተሳሳተ አቅጣጫ ሲነዳ የነበረን ተሽከርካሪ ሲከታተል በመኪናቸው በመጋጨታቸው ነው። ባለስልጣናት በአካባቢው በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ተጽዕኖ እየተስፋፋ ያለውን አደገኛ የአሽከርካሪነት ባህሪ ጋር በተያያዘ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛል።
oromo: UK keessatti balaa konkolaataa mudateen poolisoota lama dabalatee namoonni torba lubbuun darbaniiru. Balaan kun kan mudate yeroo poolisoonni daandii sirrii hin taaneen konkolaataa deemaa ture hordofaa turanitti, konkolaataan sun konkolaataa poolisii wajjin walitti bu'uun dha. Abbootiin taayitaa balaa kana qorachaa jiran yoo ta'u, rakkoon kun daandiirra kan babal'ate sababa sochii miidiyaa hawaasummaa keessatti mul'achaa jiruun akka ta'e shakkama.

title: South Korea sending first container ship through Arctic route
english: South Korea has launched its first commercial container ship, the PanStar Acro, on a trial voyage through the Arctic to reach Europe. This initiative aims to establish the region as a regular trade route by 2030, offering an alternative to traditional paths disrupted by global conflicts. However, the project faces significant criticism due to environmental concerns regarding polar ice melt and political tensions involving Russia.
amharic: ደቡብ ኮሪያ ወደ አውሮፓ የሚጓዝ የመጀመሪያውን የንግድ መርከብ በአርክቲክ ውቅያኖስ መስመር ማስጀመሯን አስታውቃለች። ይህ ሙከራ በዓለም አቀፍ ግጭቶች ምክንያት የተስተጓጎሉ የንግድ መስመሮችን ለመተካት እና እ.ኤ.አ በ2030 አርክቲክን እንደ መደበኛ የንግድ መስመር ለመጠቀም ያለመ ነው። ሆኖም ፕሮጀክቱ የአርክቲክ በረዶ መቅለጥን ሊያፋጥን ይችላል በሚል ከአካባቢ ጥበቃ ቡድኖች ትችት እየቀረበበት ሲሆን፣ ከሩሲያ ጋር ያለው የፖለቲካ ትስስርም ሌላው አወዛጋቢ ጉዳይ ሆኗል።
oromo: Koreaan Kibbaa markaba ishee jalqabaa kan gabaa akkaataa 'PanStar Acro' jedhamu karaa Arktikiin gara Awurooppaa erguun imala qorannoo jalqabdeetti. Hojii kun guddina diinagdee fi mala daldalaa yeroo ammaa walitti buiinsaan gufatan furuuf akka filannoo biraatti kan ilaallamuudha. Haa ta'u malee, yaaliin kun baqaquu barafnee Arktikii ariifachiisa jechuun gareeleen eegumsa naannoo mormii cimaa qaban yoo ta'u, hariiroo isheen Rooshiyaa wajjin gootuun immoo yaaddoo siyaasaa uumee jira.

title: Sanctioned by EU, Israeli settler steals and kills Palestinian donkey
english: An Israeli settler named Avichai Suissa, who is already under EU sanctions, has been accused of stealing a Palestinian farmer's donkey. Reports indicate that the animal was tethered to a vehicle and dragged until it died. This incident highlights ongoing tensions and reports of abuse involving settlers in the occupied territories.
amharic: በአውሮፓ ህብረት ማዕቀብ የተጣለበት አቪቻይ ሱይሳ የተባለ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪ፣ የፍልስጤማዊ ገበሬ አህያ ሰርቋል ተብሎ ተከሰሰ። እንስሳው በተሽከርካሪ ታስሮ በመጎተቱ ምክንያት በደረሰበት ጉዳት መሞቱን ዘገባዎች ያመለክታሉ። ይህ ድርጊት በተያዙት ግዛቶች ውስጥ በሰፋሪዎች የሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶችን እና ውጥረቶችን ያሳያል።
oromo: Namni biyyoota Awurooppaa irraa adabbiin irratti darbe Avichai Suissa jedhamu tokko, harree qonnaan bulaa Palastinaa tokko hatuu isaa gabaafame. Bineensi kun konkolaataa irratti hidhamee harkifamaa deemee hanga du'utti miidhameera. Gochi kun naannawwan qabamanii jiran keessatti walitti bu'iinsa fi miidhaa saafarootaan raawwatamu kan mul'isu dha.

title: Espanyol vs Real Madrid LIVE: La Liga
english: Real Madrid is beginning its new La Liga season with an away match against Espanyol at the RCDE Stadium. This game marks the return of Jose Mourinho as the head coach for the team, over a decade after his previous tenure. The match is scheduled to start at 9:30 PM local time in Barcelona.
amharic: ሪያል ማድሪድ አዲሱን የላ ሊጋ የውድድር ዘመን በሜዳው ውጭ ኤስፓኞልን በመግጠም ይጀምራል። ይህ ጨዋታ ሆዜ ሞሪንሆ ከ13 ዓመታት በኋላ እንደገና የቡድኑ ዋና አሰልጣኝ ሆነው መመለሳቸውን የሚያሳይ ነው። ጨዋታው በባርሴሎና በ9:30 የሀገር ውስጥ ሰዓት ይጀምራል።
oromo: Ri'aal Maadriid sagantaa liigii Laa Laagaa isaa haaraa dirree alaa Espanyol waliin taphachuun jalqabaa jira. Taphi kun Jose Mourinho waggaa 13 booda deebi'anii leenjisaa garee kanaa ta'uu isaanii kan agarsiisuudha. Taphi kun sa'aatii biyyaa Espaanyaatti halkan 9:30 irratti kan eegalamu ta'a.

title: How is the pro-Israel lobby influencing US elections?
english: Pro-Israel organizations like AIPAC are exerting significant financial influence over upcoming US elections. These groups are heavily funding political campaigns to defeat candidates who criticize American support for Israel. This massive influx of money highlights the growing impact of lobby groups on the outcomes of federal races.
amharic: እንደ AIPAC ያሉ እስራኤልን የሚደግፉ ቡድኖች በመጪው የአሜሪካ ምርጫዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደሩ ነው። እነዚህ ቡድኖች የአሜሪካን የእስራኤል ድጋፍ በሚቃወሙ እጩዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ በማድረግ እንዲሸነፉ እየሰሩ ነው። ይህ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የገንዘብ ዝውውር የሎቢ ቡድኖች በፌደራል ምርጫ ውጤቶች ላይ ያላቸውን ሚና አጉልቶ ያሳያል።
oromo: Dhaabbileen Israa'el deeggaran kanneen akka AIPAC filannoo Ameerikaa dhufuuf jiru irratti dhiibbaa maallaqaa cimaa uumaa jiru. Gareewwan kun kanneen deggarsa Ameerikaan Israa'eliif gootu mormanii fi morkattoota ta'an mo'achuuf maallaqa guddaa ramadaa jiru. Dhangala'aan maallaqaa kun dhiibbaan gareewwan 'lobby' jedhamanii kun bu'aa filannoo irratti qaban maal akka fakkaatu ifa godha.

title: Elche vs Barcelona: La Liga – prediction, team news, lineups
english: Barcelona is set to begin their new La Liga season with an away match against Elche this Sunday. Although the club recently acquired star midfielder Rodri, he will not be available for this opening game. Coach Hansi Flick is adjusting his team following the departure of key attackers, focusing on new signings to maintain their title defense and compete for European success.
amharic: ባርሴሎና አዲሱን የላሊጋ የውድድር ዘመን በሜዳው ውጭ ከኤልቼ ጋር በሚያደርገው ጨዋታ ይጀምራል። ክለቡ የኮከብ አማካዩን ሮድሪን ያስፈረመ ቢሆንም፣ በመክፈቻው ጨዋታ ላይ አይሰለፍም። አሰልጣኝ ሃንሲ ፍሊክ ቁልፍ አጥቂዎቻቸው በመልቀቃቸው ምክንያት ቡድኑን በማደራጀት ላይ የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ የሊግ ዋንጫውን ለመከላከል እና በአውሮፓ መድረክ ውጤታማ ለመሆን አዳዲስ ተጫዋቾችን በመጠቀም ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Barcelona Dilbata dhufu kana tapha La Liga isa jalqabaa Elche waliin alatti gaggeessa. Gareen kun taphataa giddugaleessaa beekamaa Rodri kan mallatteessise ta'us, tapha kana irratti hirmaachuu hin danda'u. Leenjisaan Hansi Flick miila ga'ee gaggeeffamaniin booda garee isaa haaromsuu fi taphattoota haaraa fayyadamuun ittisa waancaa La Liga fi milkaa'ina Awurooppaatiif qophaa'aa jira.

title: Walk-In “Human Fridges” are Japan’s newest heatwave weapon
english: Japan has introduced 'Do Hiemon Box' cooling booths to help people escape extreme heat and prevent heat-related illnesses. Initially created for laborers working outside, these personal cooling stations are now being made available in public areas. They provide a quick and effective way to lower body temperature during dangerous weather conditions.
amharic: ጃፓን በከባድ ሙቀት ምክንያት የሚከሰቱ የጤና ችግሮችን ለመከላከል 'ዶ ሂሞን ቦክስ' የተሰኙ ማቀዝቀዣ ክፍሎችን አስተዋውቃለች። መጀመሪያ ላይ ከቤት ውጭ ለሚሰሩ ሰራተኞች የተዘጋጁት እነዚህ የመቀዝቀዣ ካቢኔዎች፣ አሁን በህዝብ መሰብሰቢያ ቦታዎች ላይ እንዲገኙ እየተደረገ ነው። እነዚህ መሳሪያዎች በከባድ የአየር ሁኔታ ወቅት የሰዎችን የሰውነት ሙቀት በፍጥነት ለመቀነስ ያገለግላሉ።
oromo: Jaappaan ho'a cimaa irraa lubbuu baraaruuf jecha bakkeewwan qabbaneessaa 'Do Hiemon Box' jedhaman hojiirra oolchiteetti. Meeshaaleen kun jalqaba hojjettoota alatti hojjetaniif kan qophaa'an yoo ta'u, amma garuu iddoowwan uummataa keessatti fayyadamtootaaf dhiyaachaa jiru. Meeshaaleen kun yeroo ho'i cimaan jiru qaama namaa saffisaan qabbaneessuuf gargaaru.

title: Did DOGE cuts make America’s food safety problem worse?
english: The United States is facing a significant surge in food safety issues, marked by over 160 recalls and a major Cyclospora outbreak that resulted in thousands of illnesses and two deaths. Concerns are growing that recent budget and staffing reductions within federal oversight agencies may have compromised their ability to protect public health. Analysts are questioning whether these cuts are directly contributing to the current decline in food safety standards.
amharic: አሜሪካ ከ160 በላይ የምግብ ምርቶች መታሰሳቸውን ተከትሎ ከባድ የምግብ ደህንነት ችግሮች ገጥሟታል። በተለይም በሳይክሎስፖራ ወረርሽኝ ሳቢያ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ታመው ሁለት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በፌዴራል ደረጃ የተደረጉ የበጀትና የሰው ኃይል ቅነሳዎች የምግብ ደህንነትን የመቆጣጠር ስራን በማዳከማቸው ለዚህ ችግር መባባስ ምክንያት ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ስጋቶች ተፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Amerikaa keessatti rakkooleen nageenya nyaataa dabalaa dhufuun yaaddeessaa ta'eera. Waggaa kana keessa qofa nyaatawwan gara 160 ol ta'an gabaarraa kan deebi'an yoo ta'u, dhibee 'Cyclospora' jedhamuun namoonni kumaatamaan dhukkubsatanii lammiileen lama du'aniiru. Hir'inni baajataa fi hojjettootaa dhaabbilee mootummaa federalaa irratti godhame, to'annoo nageenya nyaataa dadhabsiisuun miidhaa kanaaf sababa ta'uu danda'a jedhamee shakkamaa jira.

title: Settlers target Palestinian homes in Occupied West Bank’s Area B
english: Israeli settlers, supported by the military, are pressuring Palestinian families to leave their homes and land in the Qaryut area of the West Bank. These actions are occurring in Area B, which is under Palestinian civil control, raising significant concerns about displacement and human rights. Local residents are facing increasing intimidation as they are forced off their properties.
amharic: በምዕራብ ባንክ በቁርዩት አካባቢ የሚገኙ የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች፣ በጦር ሠራዊቱ ድጋፍ፣ ፍልስጤማውያን ቤተሰቦችን ከመኖሪያ ቤታቸውና ከመሬታቸው እያፈናቀሉ ነው። ይህ ድርጊት በፈረንጆች የፍልስጤም አስተዳደር ሥር በሚገኘው የቢ (Area B) ክልል ውስጥ በመካሄድ ላይ ሲሆን፣ ከፍተኛ የሆነ ሰብዓዊ መብት ጥሰትና መፈናቀልን አስከትሏል። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እየደረሰባቸው ባለው ጫና ምክንያት ንብረታቸውን ለቀው ለመውጣት እየተገደዱ ነው።
oromo: Naannoo Qaryut kan Qarqara Dhihaatti argamu keessatti, qubattoonni Israa'el waraana deggarauun maatiiwwan Falasxiin mana isaanii fi lafa irraa buqqisuu irra jiru. Gochi kun naannoo B (Area B) jedhamu kan bulchiinsa Falasxiin jalatti argamu keessatti raawwatamaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, kunis yaaddoo mirga namummaa guddaa uumeera. Jiraattonni naannichaa dhiibbaa cimaa irraa kan ka'e qe'ee isaanii gadi lakkisuuf dirqamaa jiru.

title: Carney calls Trump's fresh tariffs a 'miscalculation' after trade talks collapse
english: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has labeled the latest US tariffs a major mistake following the breakdown of trade negotiations. Carney refused to agree to the US terms, stating they threatened Canada's sovereignty and offered insufficient benefits. In response, Canada plans to impose retaliatory tariffs on various American imports starting September 8 to protect its national interests.
amharic: የካናዳው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ የንግድ ድርድር በመቋረጡ ምክንያት አሜሪካ የጣለችውን አዲስ ቀረጥ ትልቅ ስህተት ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ የአሜሪካን ጥያቄ የካናዳን ሉዓላዊነት የሚጋፋ በመሆኑ አልቀበልም ብለዋል። ለዚህ ምላሽም ካናዳ ብሔራዊ ጥቅሟን ለማስጠበቅ ሲባል ከሴፕቴምበር 8 ጀምሮ በአሜሪካ ምርቶች ላይ ተመሳሳይ የሆነ የበቀል ቀረጥ ለመጣል ወስናለች።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Kaanaadaa Maark Kaarnii, mariin daldalaa erga caccabee booda tarkaanfiin gibira haaraa Ameerikaan fudhatte dogoggora guddaa ta'uusaa ibsaniiru. Kaarniin, Ameerikaan haala dhiheessite kabaja biyyattii waan tuquufi faayidaa gahaa waan hinqabneef akka hin fudhanne ibsaniiru. Kanaafis, Kaanaadaan faayidaa biyyaa eeggachuuf jecha, kutaalee Amajji 8 irraa eegalee meeshaalee Ameerikaa irraa galan irratti gibira haaloo bahannaa ta'u akka keessu murteessiteetti.

title: Over 100 ex-diplomats urge France, UK to sanction Israel over Palestine
english: A group of over 100 former British and French diplomats has issued an open letter demanding that their governments impose sanctions on Israel. They are specifically calling for a ban on arms sales and the suspension of trade agreements, arguing that Israeli settlement policies and violence are destroying the possibility of a future Palestinian state. The signatories stated that these actions violate international law and urged for equal rights for both Palestinians and Israelis.
amharic: ከ100 በላይ የቀድሞ የፈረንሳይ እና የእንግሊዝ ዲፕሎማቶች በጋራ በመሆን በእስራኤል ላይ ማዕቀብ እንዲጣል የሚጠይቅ ደብዳቤ አውጥተዋል። ዲፕሎማቶቹ የጦር መሳሪያ ሽያጭ እንዲታገድ እና የንግድ ስምምነቶች እንዲሰረዙ የጠየቁት፣ እስራኤል በተያዙ የፍልስጤም ግዛቶች የምታደርገው እንቅስቃሴ ለፍልስጤም ሀገር የመመስረት እድል አደጋ ላይ ስለጣለ ነው። እነዚህ የቀድሞ ባለስልጣናት የእስራኤል ፖሊሲዎች ዓለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጥሱ በመሆናቸው ለፍልስጤማውያን እና ለእስራኤላውያን እኩል መብት ሊረጋገጥ ይገባል ሲሉ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Humni dippilomatoota durii Faransaay fi Biriiten 100 ol ta'an, mootummoonni isaanii Israa'el irratti tarkaanfii sanadaa (sanctions) akka fudhatan gaafatan. Dippilomatoonni kunneen gurgurtaa meeshaalee waraanaa fi waliigaltee daldalaa dhaabuu kan barbaadan, Israa'el naannolee Falasxiin qabattee jirtu irratti hojiin ishee biyyi Falasxiin akka hin uumamne gufuu ta'aa jiraachuu ibsuudhaan dha. Akka isaan jedhanitti, gochi Israa'el seera idil-addunyaa cabsuu fi mirga walqixaa Falasxiinoota fi Israa'elootaaf mirkaneessuu barbaachisa.

title: Guilt, grief and strength: Gaza’s ‘sole survivor’ children face life alone
english: Thirteen-year-old Jana al-Motouq is one of thousands of children in Gaza left entirely alone after losing her immediate and extended family in an Israeli airstrike. Forced to grow up quickly, she now lives with her grandparents while struggling with the profound grief and survivor's guilt common among displaced children in the region. Her story reflects the broader tragedy of a generation facing constant uncertainty and trauma amidst ongoing conflict.
amharic: የ13 ዓመቷ ጃና አል-ሞቱቅ በጋዛ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት መላ ቤተሰቧን ካጣች በኋላ ብቻዋን የቀረች በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ህጻናት አንዷ ነች። በአሁኑ ጊዜ ከአያቶቿ ጋር በድንኳን ውስጥ የምትኖረው ጃና፣ የቤተሰብ መጥፋት በሚፈጥረው ከፍተኛ ሀዘንና የጥፋተኝነት ስሜት እየተሰቃየች ትገኛለች። የእሷ ታሪክ በጦርነቱ ምክንያት በየቀኑ ከፍተኛ ጭንቀትና መፈናቀል ውስጥ የሚገኙትን የጋዛ ህጻናት የጋራ መከራ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Jana al-Motouq kan waggaa 13 taate, erga weerara xiyyaaraan maatiishee hunda dhabdee booda, ijoollee Gaza keessatti kophaa hafan kumaatamatti lakka'aman keessaa tokko dha. Amma akaakayyuu fi akkooshee waliin dunkaana keessa kan jiraattu yoo ta'u, miira gaddaa cimaa fi of-komachuu kan ijoollee sababa waraanaan miidhaman biratti mul'atuun rakkachaa jirti. Seenaanshee, dhaloonni Gaza waraana kana keessatti rakkoo fi wallaalummaa keessa jiraachaa jiran baay'ee kan ibsu dha.

title: Carney faces crucial test after walking away from Trump's deal
english: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney is facing a major political challenge after deciding to abandon trade negotiations with the Trump administration rather than accept a deal. By choosing to impose retaliatory tariffs, Carney must now convince the Canadian public that enduring short-term economic hardship is necessary to secure better trade terms in the future. This firm stance has initiated an escalating trade conflict between the two long-standing economic allies.
amharic: የካናዳው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ ከዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ጋር የነበራቸውን የንግድ ድርድር ለማቋረጥ በመወሰናቸው ትልቅ የፖለቲካ ፈተና ገጥሟቸዋል። በአሜሪካ ላይ የተመጣጠነ የንግድ እገዳ ለመጣል በመወሰናቸው፣ የካናዳ መንግስት ይህንን ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጫና ተቋቁሞ ወደፊት የተሻለ የንግድ ስምምነት ለማምጣት እንደሚሰራ ህዝቡን ማሳመን ይኖርባቸዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል የነበረውን የቆየ የንግድ ግንኙነት ወደ ውጥረት ቀይሮታል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministira Kaanaadaa Maark Kaarnii, marii daldalaa bulchiinsa Traamp wajjin taasisaniin walii galtee irra ga’uu dhiisanii mariicha dhaabuu isaaniitiin qorumsa siyaasaa cimaa keessa galaniiru. Mootummaan Kaanaadaa gibira waraansaa (retaliatory tariffs) irra deebii fudhachuun, miidhaa diinagdee yeroo gabaabaa kana obsuun gara fuulduraatti walii galtee gaarii argamsiisuuf akka fayyadu lammiilee amansiisuu qabu. Tarkaanfiin kun hariiroo daldalaa biyyoota lamaanii gidduu jiru gara wal dhabdee cimaatti geesseetti.

title: Israeli drone strike on ‘civilian vehicle’ injures several in Syria
english: An Israeli drone strike hit a civilian delivery truck near the town of Beit Jinn in southwestern Syria, resulting in injuries to a driver. While the Syrian government condemned the attack as a violation of its sovereignty and international law, the Israeli military claimed the target was a militant planning imminent attacks. Residents reported the presence of surveillance drones in the area for several days prior to the explosion.
amharic: የእስራኤል ድሮን በደቡብ ምዕራብ ሶሪያ ቤይት ጂን በተባለች ከተማ አቅራቢያ የሚገኝ የሲቪል ማመላለሻ መኪናን በመምታቱ የአሽከርካሪውን ጨምሮ በርካቶች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። የሶሪያ መንግስት ጥቃቱን የሀገሪቱን ሉዓላዊነት የጣሰ ህገ-ወጥ ድርጊት ሲል ሲያወግዘው፣ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ክፍል ግን ኢላማው የነበረው ጥቃት ለመፈጸም ሲዘጋጅ የነበረ ታጣቂ መሆኑን ገልጿል። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ፍንዳታው ከመከሰቱ ቀናት በፊት የክትትል ድሮኖች በስፍራው ሲበሩ እንደነበር ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Xiyyaarri malee kan biyya Israa'el kibba-lixaa Suuriyaatti konkolaataa fe'umsaa namoota nagaa rukutuun ishee miidhaa geessiseera. Mootummaan Suuriyaa gocha kana cabsa seeraa fi sarbamuu kabaja biyyaa jechuun balaaleffatus, waraanni Israa'el garuu kan rukutame namoota weerara gaggeessuuf qophaa'aa turan jedheera. Jiraattonni naannichaa akka jedhanitti, miidhaan kun osoo hin ga'in guyyoota muraasa dura xiyyaarotni basaastuu Israa'el bakka sana naanna'aa turan.

title: Iran says repair of South Pars refinery 70 percent complete
english: The repair process for Iran's South Pars Phase 14 gas refinery, which was damaged during an Israeli strike last year, has reached 70 percent completion. Officials expect the facility to be fully operational again by the end of the year. Once finished, the restored section will be successfully reconnected to the country's main production network.
amharic: ባለፈው ዓመት በእስራኤል ጥቃት ጉዳት የደረሰበት የኢራኑ የደቡብ ፓርስ 14ኛ ምዕራፍ ጋዝ ማጣሪያ የጥገና ሥራ 70 በመቶ ደርሷል። የኩባንያው ዋና ሥራ አስፈጻሚ ማጣሪያው በዓመቱ መጨረሻ ሙሉ በሙሉ ወደ ቀድሞ ሥራው እንደሚመለስ ገልጸዋል። የተጠገነው ክፍልም ከኢራን ዋና የምርት ሂደት ጋር እንደሚቀላቀል ይጠበቃል።
oromo: buufata qulqulleessa gaazii 'South Pars Phase 14' kan bara darbe haleellaa Israa'eelirratti miidhame ture suphuun dhibbeentaa 70 ga'eera. Hojjettoota olaanoon akka jedhanitti, buufatichi dhuma bara kanaatti guututti deebi'ee hojii jalqaba. Yeroo suphamee xumuramu, kutaan miidhame ture qaama oomisha biyyattii ta'ee deebi'ee hojiitti gala.

title: What did war with the US reveal about Iran’s weapons capabilities?
english: The Iranian military is currently refining its defense strategies in response to new, severe economic sanctions announced by the United States. While Iranian officials have refrained from publicly displaying new weaponry to maintain strategic secrecy, they claim to have significantly ramped up domestic arms production since their conflict with the US and Israel began. Military leaders assert that this decentralized manufacturing network and improved strike capabilities serve as a vital deterrent against ongoing foreign threats.
amharic: የኢራን ወታደራዊ አመራሮች አሜሪካ በሀገሪቱ ላይ የጣለችውን አዲስ እና ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ ተከትሎ የመከላከያ ስልቶቻቸውን በማሻሻል ላይ ናቸው። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት የሀገሪቱን የጦር መሳሪያ ምስጢር ለመጠበቅ ሲሉ አዳዲስ መሳርያዎችን ይፋ ከማድረግ ቢቆጠቡም፣ ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ እና ከእስራኤል ጋር ከተፈጠረው ግጭት ወዲህ የጦር መሳሪያ ምርታቸውን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ማሳደጋቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ የተጠናከረ የሀገር ውስጥ ምርት እና የላቀ የመከላከያ አቅም፣ በሀገሪቱ ላይ ለሚቃጡ የውጭ ስጋቶች እንደ ዋና መከላከያ እንደሚጠቅም የኢራን ወታደራዊ መሪዎች ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Humni waraanaa Iraan tarkaanfii diinagdee cimaa Ameerikaan irratti fudhatte hordofee, tarsiimoo ittisa isaa fooyyeffachaa jira. Aangoonni Iraan iccitii meeshaalee waraanaa isaanii eeggachuuf jecha meeshaalee haaraa ifatti baasuufi baasuu baatanis, waraana Ameerikaa fi Israa'el waliin ta'een booda oomisha meeshaalee waraanaa dachaan dabaluu isaanii ibsaniiru. Hoggantoonni waraanaa kun akka jedhanitti, oomishni biyya keessaa babal'atee fi dandeettiin haleellaa isaanii fooyya'uun, sodaachisa alaa ittisuuf gargaaraa jira.

title: Man Utd humiliated at Hull to open Premier League account
english: Manchester United began their Premier League season with a disappointing 2-0 loss against newly promoted Hull City. Despite being favorites to challenge for the title, United conceded two goals in the first half and struggled to create significant chances. Hull City overcame their injury crisis to secure their first victory over United in several years, leaving manager Michael Carrick under immediate pressure.
amharic: ማንችስተር ዩናይትድ የፕሪሚየር ሊግ የውድድር ዘመኑን አዲስ ባደገው ሀል ሲቲ 2 ለ 0 በመሸነፍ በከባድ ሽንፈት ጀምሯል። ለዋንጫ እንደሚፎካከሩ የሚጠበቁት ማንችስተር ዩናይትዶች በጨዋታው የመጀመሪያ አጋማሽ ሁለት ግቦችን በማስተናገድ ውጤታማ መሆን ተስኗቸዋል። ሀል ሲቲ በርካታ ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ተጫዋቾች ቢኖሩትም፣ የዩናይትድን ቡድን በማሸነፍ አስገራሚ ውጤት አስመዝግበዋል፤ ይህም በአሰልጣኝ ማይክል ካሪክ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Maanchastar Yuunayiteddii tapha isaa isa jalqabaa priimiyaar liigii irratti kilabii haaraa guddatee dhufe Hull City irratti 2-0 injifatamuu isaatiin jalqabe. Kilabichi qophii cimaa godhee waggaa kana mata duree liigichaa mo'achuuf kan karoorfate ta'us, qabxii tokko illee utuu hin argatin gadi bahuun isaa baay'ee rifachiiseera. Hull City miidhaa fi madaa taphattoota isaanii hedduu keessa utuu jiranuu, garee Yuunayiteddii mo'achuu danda'aniiru; kunis dhiibbaa guddaa leenjisaa Maaykil Kaarik irratti uumeera.

title: Israeli forces reportedly use phosphorus shells in attacks on southern Lebanon
english: Israeli military forces conducted significant airstrikes and artillery bombardments across various locations in southern Lebanon, reportedly utilizing phosphorus shells. The attacks caused widespread damage to residential areas, particularly in the town of Bayt al-Sayyad where numerous homes were destroyed. Ongoing military activity was also reported in several surrounding villages and valleys throughout the night and into Saturday morning.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙ በርካታ አካባቢዎች ላይ የአየር ጥቃቶችን እና ከባድ የጦር መሳሪያ ድብደባዎችን አድርሰዋል፣ ይህም ፎስፈረስን የያዙ ቦምቦችን እንደተጠቀሙ ተዘግቧል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በተለይም በባይት አል-ሰያድ ከተማ የሚገኙ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን ሙሉ በሙሉ በማውደም ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። በተለያዩ የሊባኖስ መንደሮች እና ሸለቆዎች ውስጥ የነበረው ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ቅዳሜ ማለዳ ድረስ ቀጥሎ እንደነበር የሀገሪቱ የመገናኛ ብዙኃን ዘግበዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israaʼel kibba Libaanoositti qilleensaafi rukuttaa meeshaa waraana gurguddaan haleellaa geggeessaniiru; haleellaa kana keessattis rookeettiiwwan fosfoorasiin guutaman fayyadamuu isaanii gabaasameera. Haleellaan kun manneen jireenyaa keessattuu magaalaa Bayt al-Sayyad keessa jiran irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisee jira. Hojiin waraanaafi dhukaasni kanneen biroo gandootaafi sulula naannawaa sana jiran keessatti halkan guutuu hanga ganama Sanbataatti itti fufee ture.

title: Syria condemns Israeli strike on 'civilian vehicle' near Damascus
english: The Syrian government has strongly denounced an Israeli drone strike on a private vehicle near Damascus that left one person injured. While Israel justified the operation by claiming the individual posed an immediate security threat, Syria characterized the act as a violation of its national sovereignty. This incident follows recent Israeli airstrikes in the Idlib province and has further escalated regional tensions.
amharic: የሶሪያ መንግስት በደማስቆ አቅራቢያ በግል መኪና ላይ በእስራኤል የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት በጥብቅ አውግዟል፣ ጥቃቱም አንድ ሰው እንዲቆስል አድርጓል። እስራኤል ግለሰቡ ለሰራዊቷ ስጋት በመሆኑ ጥቃቱን እንደፈጸመች ስትገልጽ፣ ሶሪያ ግን ይህ ድርጊት የሀገሪቱን ሉዓላዊነት የሚጥስ መሆኑን አስታውቃለች። ይህ ክስተት በቅርቡ በኢድሊብ ግዛት ከተፈጸሙት የአየር ጥቃቶች ጋር ተያይዞ በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Siriyaa magaalaa Damasqoo biratti konkolaataa dhuunfaa tokko irratti haleellaa Israa’el raawwatte cimssee balaaleffateera; haleellaa kanaanis namni tokko miidhameera. Israa’el namni haleellichi irratti raawwatame kun waraana ishee irratti balaa waan qaqqabsiisuuf kan tarkaanfii fudhatte ta’uu ibsiteerti. Siriyaan garuu gochi kun kabajama biyyattii cabsuu ta’uu ibsuun, haleellaan kun waldhabiinsa naannichaa caalaatti akka hammaatu taasiseera.

title: Fans and police injured in pitch invasion during ‘high risk’ German Cup tie
english: A German Cup match between Waldhof Mannheim and Kaiserslautern was disrupted for 30 minutes following a violent pitch invasion and the firing of flares. The chaos resulted in approximately 100 injuries, including 35 police officers, with eight individuals requiring hospitalization. Despite the significant unrest, security forces restored order, allowing the game to conclude with a 1-0 victory for Kaiserslautern.
amharic: በዋልድሆፍ ማንሃይም እና በካይዘርስላውተር መካከል በተደረገው የጀርመን ዋንጫ ጨዋታ ወቅት ደጋፊዎች ሜዳ በመውረራቸው እና የእሳት ቃጠሎ በመፈጠሩ ጨዋታው ለ30 ደቂቃ ተቋርጦ ነበር። በዚህ ግጭት 35 የፖሊስ አባላትን ጨምሮ ወደ 100 የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን ስምንት ሰዎች ሆስፒታል ገብተዋል። ከፍተኛ የፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ከተደረገ በኋላ ጨዋታው ቀጥሎ በካይዘርስላውተር 1 ለ 0 አሸናፊነት ተጠናቋል።
oromo: Tapha waancaa Jarmanii kan Waldhof Mannheim fi Kaiserslautern gidduutti gaggeeffame irratti, gochi gadi-bu'iinsa dirree fi boba'aan gubatu uumamuu isaan taphichi daqiiqaa 30f addaan citee ture. Waraansii kun poolisoota 35 dabalatee namoota 100 ga'an irratti miidhaa kan geessise yoo ta'u, namoonni saddeet hospitaala galanii jiru. Humnoonni nageenyaa dirree to'annoo jala oolchuun taphichi akka itti fufu taasisuun, Kaiserslautern 1-0 injifannoo argachuun xumuramee jira.

title: Fourteen killed in strike on Myanmar monastery
english: At least fourteen elderly civilians were killed when Myanmar's military carried out air strikes on a monastery in the Sagaing region. The victims were attending a meditation retreat for Buddhist Lent when the site was bombed twice. This attack is part of the ongoing civil war that has plagued the country since the 2021 military coup.
amharic: በማያንማር የሳጋይንግ ክልል በሚገኝ ገዳም ላይ ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በፈጸሙት የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ አስራ አራት አረጋውያን ሲቪሎች ተገድለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው ሰላማዊ ሰዎች ለቡዲስት በዓል ማሰላሰል ላይ እያሉ ሲሆን፣ ተቋሙ ሁለት ጊዜ በቦምብ ተመቷል። ይህ ድርጊት ከ2021 ወታደራዊ መፈንቅለ መንግስት ወዲህ በአገሪቱ እየተካሄደ ካለው የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት አንዱ አካል ነው።
oromo: Godina Saagaayin kan Maayanmaritti, waraanni mootummaa mana amantii tokko irratti xiyyaaraan haleellaa raawwateen namoonni ja'atami afur du'aniiru. Namoonni du'an kunneen guyyaa ayyaana amantii Buddistiif sagada irratti kan argaman yoo ta'u, iddoon kunis si'a lama bombiin rukutameera. Haleellaan kun waraana cimaa biyyattii keessatti bara 2021 mootummaan fonqolchee erga aangoo qabate as gaggeeffamaa jiru keessaa isa tokko.

title: Indonesia bolsters troop numbers to combat Borneo wildfires
english: The Indonesian government is deploying 1,500 additional soldiers and extra helicopters to Borneo to contain widespread wildfires exacerbated by dry El Nino weather conditions. These blazes have destroyed over 200,000 hectares of land, causing severe air pollution that is impacting public health in both Indonesia and neighboring Malaysia. President Prabowo Subianto has prioritized immediate intervention to stop the fires from spreading further across the region.
amharic: የኢንዶኔዢያ መንግሥት በኤል নিনዮ የአየር ንብረት ክስተት ምክንያት በቦርኒዮ ደሴት እየተስፋፋ የሚገኘውን የሰደድ እሳት ለመቆጣጠር 1,500 ተጨማሪ ወታደሮችን እና ሄሊኮፕተሮችን አሰማርቷል። እስካሁን ከ200,000 ሄክታር በላይ መሬት የነደደ ሲሆን፣ በደረሰው የጭስ ብክለት ምክንያት የሁለቱም የኢንዶኔዢያ እና የማሌዢያ ነዋሪዎች ጤና አደጋ ላይ ወድቋል። ፕሬዝዳንት ፕሮቦዎ ሱቢያንቶ የእሳቱን መስፋፋት በአስቸኳይ ለማቆም ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Indoneeziyaa balaa ibiddaa naannoo Boroniyoo keessatti ka’e to’achuuf loltoota dabalataa 1,500 fi heelikopteroota gara achi ergeera. Balaan ibiddaa kun haala qilleensa El-Niiniyootti fayyadamuun lafa hektaara 200,000 ol barbadeesseera, kunis qilleensa naannoo sanaa faaluun jiraattota biyyoota Indoneeziyaafi Maaleeshiyaa miidhuu irra jira. Preezidaantiin biyyattii balaan kun akka hin babal’anneef tarkaanfii ariifachiisaa fudhachaa jiru.

title: Is Trump making Latin America great again?
english: A surge of right-wing leaders is taking control across Latin America, supported by US President Donald Trump's influence and financial pressure. Critics warn that this trend threatens to revive past patterns of violence and human rights abuses while prioritizing policies that increase poverty and environmental damage. Experts suggest that these new administrations are actively aligning themselves with American interests at the expense of their own citizens' well-being.
amharic: በላቲን አሜሪካ በፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ድጋፍና ተፅዕኖ የቀኝ ዘመም መሪዎች ቁጥር እየጨመረ ነው። ይህ አካሄድ በክልሉ ቀደም ሲል የነበሩትን የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶችና ግጭቶች እንደገና ሊቀሰቅስ እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች ይገልጻሉ። እነዚህ አዳዲስ መንግስታት በአሜሪካ ፍላጎት ላይ በማተኮራቸው የየሀገራቸውን ዜጎች በድህነትና በአካባቢ ጥበቃ ችግሮች ውስጥ እየጣሉ መሆናቸው ተነግሯል።
oromo: Godina Ameerikaa Laatin keessatti guddinni hoggantoota mirga-raree (right-wing) dhiibbaa fi gargaarsa pirezidaant Doonaald Tiraampin dabalaa jira. Akkaataa kanaan biyyoota sana keessatti waldhabdee fi sarbama mirga namoomaa kanaan dura ture deebi'ee akka hin kaane sodaatama. Mootummoonni haaraan kunneen faayidaa Ameerikaa dursuun, lammiilee isaanii hiyyummaa fi mancaatii naannoo hamaa keessatti kufaa jiraachuu gabaasni kun ni ibsa.

title: Israeli forces reportedly use phosphorus shells in attacks on southern Lebanon
english: Israeli military forces launched heavy artillery strikes, air raids, and machine-gun fire across multiple towns in southern Lebanon. Reports indicate that white phosphorus shells were used during the attacks, causing significant damage to civilian homes. The use of this incendiary weapon in populated areas is widely condemned due to the severe, indiscriminate injuries it inflicts on civilians.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙ በርካታ ከተሞች ላይ ከባድ የጦር መሳሪያ ድብደባ፣ የአየር ጥቃት እና የተኩስ ልውውጥ አድርገዋል። በነዚህ ጥቃቶች ወቅት ነጭ ፎስፈረስን የያዙ ቦምቦች ጥቅም ላይ እንደዋሉ እና በሲቪል መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እንደደረሰ ተገልጿል። ነጭ ፎስፈረስ በህዝብ በሚኖርባቸው አካባቢዎች መጠቀም ሰላማዊ ሰዎችን ለአደጋ ስለሚዳርግ በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በጥብቅ የተወገዘ ድርጊት ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el kibba Libaanoositti magaalota hedduu irratti haleellaa xiyyaaraa fi meeshaa gurguddaan haleelaniiru. Haleellaa kana keessatti rasaasni 'waayit foosfaras' jedhamu fayyadamuu fi mana jireenyaa namoota nagaa irratti miidhaa guddaan gahuun gabaafameera. Meeshaan kun bakka namoonni nagaa jiraatanitti fayyadamamuun isaa, miidhaa hamaa waan geessisuuf seera idil-addunyaatiin kan balaaleffatamuu fi dhoorkamaa dha.

title: Israelis says Syria air base strike motivated by alleged Turkish plans to deploy forces there
english: Israel recently launched an airstrike on a Syrian military base, citing intelligence that Turkey intended to use the facility in a way that threatened Israeli national security. Before carrying out the attack, Israeli officials claim they sent a formal warning to the Syrian government. Both Syria and Turkey have denied these allegations, while some American officials have criticized the operation as an unnecessary provocation.
amharic: እስራኤል በቅርቡ በሶሪያ በሚገኝ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ የአየር ጥቃት አድርሳለች፤ ጥቃቱ የተፈፀመው ቱርክ ጣቢያውን ለደህንነቷ አስጊ በሆነ መንገድ ልትጠቀምበት እንደሆነ መረጃ በማግኘቷ እንደሆነ ገልጻለች። እስራኤል ጥቃቱን ከመፈጸሟ በፊት ለሶሪያ መንግስት ማስጠንቀቂያ እንደሰጠች አስታውቃለች። ይሁን እንጂ ሶሪያ እና ቱርክ የይገባኛል ጥያቄውን ውድቅ ያደረጉ ሲሆን አንዳንድ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት እርምጃውን አላስፈላጊ ቅስቀሳ በማለት ተችተውታል።
oromo: Israa'el dhiheenya kana buufata waraanaa Suuriyaa irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwatteetti; haleellaan kunis Turkeen buufata kana bakka nageenya Israa'el miidhuu danda'uutti fayyadamuu akka barbaaddu odeeffannoo argachuu isheen kan godhame ta'uufi ibsite. Israa'el haleellaa kana raawwachuu ishee dura mootummaa Suuriyaaf akeekkachiisa dabarsuu ishee ibsiteerti. Ta'us, Suuriyaanis ta'e Turkeen himata kana kan morman yoo ta'u, qondaallonni Ameerikaa tokko tokko immoo tarkaanfii kana adeemsa barbaachisaa hin taane fi jeequmsa uumuu danda'u jechuun balaaleffataniiru.

title: Amhara Nationalism Faces Historic Choice in National Dialogue
english: Ethiopia is undergoing significant political changes as the Prosperity Party moves away from power-sharing among ethnic groups toward a system based on population size. This transition challenges the traditional influence of Amhara political thought, which historically identified closely with the nation's central authority. As the upcoming National Dialogue considers constitutional reforms, Amhara nationalism faces a pivotal moment that may shift its position from the core of the state to its periphery.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ በብልጽግና ፓርቲ አማካኝነት ከብሔር ብሔረሰቦች እኩል የሥልጣን ክፍፍል ይልቅ በሕዝብ ቁጥር ላይ በተመሰረተ የፖለቲካ ሥርዓት ውስጥ እያለፈች ነው። ይህ ለውጥ በአገሪቱ ማዕከላዊ አስተዳደር ውስጥ ትልቅ ሚና የነበረውን የአማራ ፖለቲካዊ አስተሳሰብ እየፈታተነው ይገኛል። በመካሄድ ላይ ባለው የብሔራዊ ምክክር ኮንፈረንስ የሚጠበቁ የሕገ-መንግስት ማሻሻያዎች የአማራን የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ ከማዕከል ወደ ዳር ሊገፉት የሚችሉበት ታሪካዊ ወቅት ላይ ደርሰናል።
oromo: Itoophiyaan yeroo ammaa mootummaa Paartii Badhaadhinaa waliin ta'uun, sirna gitaa fi qoodinsa aangootti irraa gara sirna baay'ina ummataa irratti hundaa'etti ce'aa jirti. Jijjiirramni kun yaada siyaasaa Amaaraa kan yeroo dheeraaf giddugala mootummaa waliin hidhata cimaa qabaachaa ture irratti dhiibbaa uumaa jira. Mariin Biyyaalessaa ammaa kun jijjiirrama heeraa akka fidutti kan eegamu yoo ta'u, kunis siyaasni Amaaraa iddoo dur qabu giddugala irraa gara qarqaraatti akka adeemu taasisuu danda'a.

title: Jewish activists push back against Israeli settlers
english: A group of Jewish activists is actively working in Palestinian villages located in the occupied West Bank to safeguard local residents. Their presence serves as a peaceful monitor intended to discourage violent actions and unauthorized entries by Israeli settlers. By maintaining a protective watch, these activists hope to reduce conflict and provide security to the Palestinian communities in the region.
amharic: አንድ ቡድን የሆኑ አይሁዳውያን አክቲቪስቶች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ በሚገኙ የፍልስጤም መንደሮች ውስጥ በመገኘት የአካባቢውን ነዋሪዎች እየረዱ ይገኛሉ። የእነሱ መገኘት የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች ሊፈጽሙ የሚችሉትን የጥቃት ድርጊቶች ለመከላከል እና ለመግታት ያለመ ነው። እነዚህ አክቲቪስቶች በቦታው በመገኘት ግጭቶችን ለመቀነስ እና ለፍልስጤም ማህበረሰቦች ደህንነትን ለመስጠት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Gareen aktivistoota Yihuudii ta'an tokko, naannoo Qilleensa-gadi (West Bank) kan Falasxiin keessatti argamanitti argamuun uummata naannichaa gargaaraa jiru. Argamuun isaanii kun, weerara fi gochaa diinummaa qonnaan bultoota Israa'el irraa dhufu ittisuuf akka gaaddisaatti tajaajila. Aktivistoonni kun rakkoo fi walitti bu'iinsa hir'isuu fi nageenya hawaasa Falasxiin mirkaneessuuf onnee godhatanii hojjetaa jiru.

title: Two Palestinians wounded in Israeli raid near Nablus, settlers and troops storm towns in Ramallah and Jenin
english: Israeli forces recently conducted military raids across the occupied West Bank, resulting in two Palestinians being injured in Beit Furik. In separate incidents, Israeli settlers attacked the town of Deir Dibwan, while troops arrested two men during home searches in the village of Faqqu'a. These operations involved widespread property damage and the questioning of local residents in the affected areas.
amharic: የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት በተለያዩ ከተሞች ወታደራዊ ዘመቻዎችን አካሂደዋል። በቤይት ፉሪክ በተደረገው ጥቃት ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን፣ በዴየር ዲብዋን ደግሞ የአይሁድ ሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። በተጨማሪም በፋቁአ መንደር ወታደሮቹ ሁለት ወጣቶችን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋሉ ሲሆን በበርካታ ቤቶች ላይም ፍተሻ በማካሄድ የንብረት ውድመት አድርሰዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el naannoo West Bank keessatti duula waraanaa geggeessaniin namoonni lama magaalaa Beit Furik keessatti miidhamaniiru. Gocha kana cinaatti, qubattoonni Israa'el magaalaa Deir Dibwan irratti haleellaa kan raawwatan yoo ta'u, humnoonni waraanaa ganda Faqqu'a keessatti dargaggoota lama qabaniiru. Duula kanaan mana jireenyaa hedduu sakatta'uudhaan qabeenya mancaasuu fi jiraattota gaafachuu gabaasameera.

title: 'After Israel's annihilation of Gaza, can I ever return home?' Opinion by Bahzad al Akhras
english: Bahzad al Akhras reflects on the loss of his home in Gaza after realizing that he can no longer return to the familiar surroundings of his past. While studying in the UK, he previously felt comforted by the certainty that his family and neighborhood remained intact, but the current conflict has destroyed that sense of security. He now questions what remains of his identity and home when the physical space he once belonged to has been decimated.
amharic: ባህዛድ አል አክራስ የጋዛ ቤት መውደም እና ወደዚያ መመለስ እንደማይችል በመገንዘቡ የተሰማውን ጥልቅ ስሜት ይገልጻል። በእንግሊዝ ሀገር በሚማርበት ጊዜ ቤተሰቡ እና ሰፈሩ እንደማይለወጡ በማሰቡ እርግጠኛ ነበር፣ ነገር ግን አሁን ያለው ጦርነት ያንን የደህንነት ስሜት አጥፍቶታል። አሁን መኖሪያ ቤቱ በአካል ከጠፋ በኋላ ማንነቱ እና የትውልድ ቦታው ምን እንደሆነ በመጠየቅ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Bahzaad al Akraas, qe’ee isaa Gaazaatti deebi’uun akka hin danda’amne erga hubatee booda miira gaddi itti dhaga’ame ibsa. Yeroo biyya Ingilizitti barachaa turetti, maatiin isaa fi naannoon isaa akka jiranitti akka fayyan isatti dhaga’amaa ture, garuu waraanni amma jiru nageenya sana balleesseera. Amma mana inni dur keessa jiraachaa ture diigamee booda, eenyummaan isaa fi bakki inni itti guddate maal akka ta’e gaaffii keessa galchaa jira.

title: Israeli army claims attack in southern Syria
english: The Israeli military reported conducting a strike in southern Syria, alleging that the target was an individual planning an attack. Reports from Al Jazeera indicate that the incident involved an Israeli drone hitting a vehicle in the Beit Jinn area. Israel has not yet offered proof to substantiate its claims regarding the individual's intentions.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በደቡባዊ ሶሪያ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን አስታውቋል፤ ጥቃቱንም ያነጣጠረው ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር በዝግጅት ላይ በነበረ ሰው ላይ ነው ብሏል። አልጀዚራ እንደዘገበው ከሆነ፣ የእስራኤል ድሮን በቤይት ጂን አካባቢ በአንድ የጭነት መኪና ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝራለች። እስራኤል ለዚህ ክሷ እስካሁን ድረስ ምንም አይነት ማስረጃ አላቀረበችም።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el gammoojjii Kibba Suuriyaa keessatti haleellaa raawwachuu isaa beeksiseera; haleellaanis namicha haleellaa raawwachuuf qophaa'aa ture irratti kan xiyyeeffate ta'uu ibseera. Gabaasni Al Jazeera akka ibsutti, diroonni Israa'el magaalaa Beyt Jiin keessatti konkolaataatti haleellaa raawwachuu ishee gabaaseera. Israa'el ammas ta'e himata ishee kanaaf ragaa kan hin dhiyeessin yoo ta'u, waan namichi sun karoorfate jedhe irratti ragaa hin qabdu.

title: After Israel's annihilation of Gaza, can I ever return home?
english: The author, a Palestinian PhD student, reflects on the profound loss of their home in Gaza following its destruction during the ongoing conflict. While living abroad previously, the author felt comforted by the certainty that their family and home remained in Gaza, serving as a permanent anchor. Now, with their house reduced to rubble, the author struggles with the psychological trauma of having no place to return to and contemplates the deep meaning of home as both a physical and emotional identity.
amharic: በጋዛ ግጭት ወቅት ቤታቸው በመውደሙ የትውልድ ቦታቸውን ያጡ አንድ የፒኤችዲ ተማሪ፣ ስላጋጠማቸው ጥልቅ የሆነ የመኖሪያ ቤት መጥፋት ስሜት ይገልጻሉ። ቀደም ሲል በውጭ አገር ሲኖሩ፣ ቤተሰባቸው እና መኖሪያ ቤታቸው በጋዛ ስላለ ብቻ የትም ቢሄዱ የሚመለሱበት ሥር እንደነበራቸው ይናገራሉ። አሁን ግን ቤታቸው በመፍረሱ፣ ወደ ቤት የመመለስ ተስፋቸው በመክሸፉና የትውልድ ቦታቸው ትርጉም በልባቸው ውስጥ ብቻ በመቅረቱ የተሰማቸውን ስሜታዊ ቀውስ ያንጸባርቃሉ።
oromo: Barataan sadarkaa PhD kan ta'an barreessichi, waraana Gaza keessatti mana isaanii dhabuun miira badaa itti dhaga'ame ibsu. Kanaan dura biyya alaatti yeroo turanitti, maatiifi manni isaanii Gaza keessatti waan jiraniif, yeroo hundumaa deebi'anii bakka itti boqotan akka qaban amanuun jajjabaachaa turan. Amma garuu mana isaanii diigamee fi bakka deebi'anii dhaqan waan dhabaniif, garaa garaa ta'ee fi miira sammuu isaanii miidhe keessa darbuu isaanii fi hiika mana jireenyaa qabatamaa ta'e irratti yaaduu isaanii ibsatu.

title: CONCACAF asks Infantino to skip youth event amid FIFA governance crisis
english: The CONCACAF president has requested that FIFA leader Gianni Infantino avoid attending an upcoming youth soccer tournament in the Dominican Republic. This request stems from the ongoing governance crisis at FIFA, as several regional confederations are pushing for Infantino's resignation over controversial proposals. Organizers fear that his presence would distract from the sporting event and shift the media focus toward his political troubles.
amharic: የኮንካካፍ ፕሬዚዳንት የፊፋው መሪ ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ በዶሚኒካን ሪፐብሊክ በሚካሄድ የወጣቶች እግር ኳስ ውድድር ላይ እንዳይገኙ ጠይቀዋል። ይህ ጥያቄ የመጣው በፊፋ ውስጥ በተፈጠረው የአስተዳደር ቀውስ ሳቢያ በርካታ ክልላዊ ማህበራት በአወዛጋቢ ውሳኔዎቹ ምክንያት ኢንፋንቲኖ ከስልጣን እንዲለቁ እየገፋፉ በመሆናቸው ነው። አዘጋጆቹ የኢንፋንቲኖ መገኘት ከስፖርታዊ ውድድሩ ትኩረትን በመሰረቅ መገናኛ ብዙኃን ወደ ፖለቲካዊ ችግሮቹ እንዲያተኩሩ ያደርጋል የሚል ስጋት አላቸው።
oromo: Pirezedantiin CONCACAF hogganaan FIFA Giyaanii Infantinoo dorgommii kubbaa miilaa dargaggootaa kan Rippabilika Doominikaanitti adeemsifamu irratti akka hin argamne gaafataniiru. Gaaffiin kun kan dhufe rakkoo bulchiinsa FIFA keessatti uumamee fi gamtaawwan naannolee hedduun yaada mormii guddaa kaasee jiruun walqabatee Infantinoon aangoo akka gadhiisan dhiibbaa gochaa waan jiraniifidha. Qopheessitoonni dorgommichaa, argamuun isaanii xiyyeeffannoo miidiyaalee dorgommicha irraa gara rakkoo siyaasaatti akka jijjiiru sodaatu.

title: The Berlin Wall separated his family. Its legacy still endures
english: The article explores the long-term impact of the Berlin Wall by sharing the story of Erich Guetinger, who was separated from his relatives due to the division of Germany. Even with political partition making travel difficult and bureaucratic, families faced extreme challenges and surveillance to maintain connections across the border. This narrative highlights the human cost of political borders and the lasting scars they leave on families.
amharic: ጽሁፉ የበርሊን ግንብ በጀርመን ህዝብ ላይ ያደረሰውን የረጅም ጊዜ ተጽእኖ የኤሪክ ጉቲንገርን የግል ታሪክ መሰረት በማድረግ ይዳስሳል። በፖለቲካዊ ክፍፍል ምክንያት ቤተሰቦች ተለያይተው የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ድንበር አቋርጦ ለመገናኘት የሚደረገው ጉዞ እጅግ አድካሚ እና ከፍተኛ የመንግስት ቁጥጥር የሚደረግበት ነበር። ይህ ታሪክ የፖለቲካ ድንበሮች በሰው ልጅ ህይወት እና በቤተሰብ ግንኙነት ላይ የሚያሳድሩትን ጥልቅ ጠባሳ ያሳያል።
oromo: Barruun kun kan xiyyeeffatu miidhaa duraan dallaan Barlin biyya Jarman irratti qaqqabsiise irratti yoo ta'u, seenaa namoota maatii irraa gargar ba'anii turan keessaa kan Erich Guetinger ibsa. Gargar bahuun biyyattii kun imala maatii gidduutti taasifamu baay'ee ulfaataa fi hordoffii mootummaan kan guutame taasisee ture. Seenaan kun daangaan siyaasaa jireenya namootaa fi hariiroo maatii irratti dhiibbaa akkamii akka qabu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Russian strikes kill 6 people in Ukraine, day after shopping complex attack
english: Russian aerial attacks across various Ukrainian regions have resulted in six deaths and dozens of injuries, following a devastating strike on a shopping mall in Kryvyi Rih that left 16 people dead. In retaliation, a Ukrainian drone strike hit a home in southern Russia, killing two children and injuring their parents. These incidents mark a significant escalation in violence as both nations continue to target civilian infrastructure and residential areas.
amharic: በዩክሬን በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች በሩሲያ በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ ስድስት ሰዎች ሲገደሉ በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በክሪቪ ሪህ ከተማ የገበያ ማዕከል ላይ ደርሶ የነበረው እና 16 ሰዎችን የገደለው ጥቃት እንደቀጠለ የተፈጸመ ነው። ለዚህ ምላሽ በሩሲያ ደቡባዊ ክፍል በዩክሬን ድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ህጻናት ህይወታቸው ማለፉ ተሰምቷል።
oromo: Humni Ruusiyaa naannolee Yuukireen gara garaatti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwateen namoonni ja'a ajjeefamanii hedduun madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan hordofe erga magaala Kirivii Rihitti bakka gabaa irratti haleellaa raawwatamee namoonni 16 du'anii booda dha. Gama biraatiin, haleellaa diroonii Yuukireen biyya Ruusiyaatti raawwatteen ijoolleen lama du'anii warri isaanii madaa'uun gabaasameera.

title: Hundreds of children take part in swimming class on Gaza’s shore
english: Over 1,300 children in Gaza recently participated in a large-scale swimming event along the coast. This initiative aims to provide physical activity and a brief escape from the deep trauma caused by the ongoing war. Such programs are essential for supporting the mental health of the more than one million children currently affected by the conflict.
amharic: በጋዛ የባህር ዳርቻ ከ1,300 በላይ የሚሆኑ ህጻናት በተሳተፉበት ትልቅ የመዋኛ ፕሮግራም ተካሂዷል። ይህ ተነሳሽነት ህጻናቱ ከአካላዊ እንቅስቃሴ በተጨማሪ በጦርነቱ ምክንያት የደረሰባቸውን የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ እንዲቋቋሙ ለመርዳት ያለመ ነው። በአሁኑ ወቅት በጦርነቱ የተጎዱ ከ1.1 ሚሊዮን በላይ ህጻናት የአእምሮ ጤና ድጋፍ እንደሚያስፈልጋቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Gazaatti ijoolleen 1,300 ol ta'an qarqara galaanaatti sagantaa daakanii irratti hirmaataniiru. Sagantaan kun ijoolleen sochii qaamaa akka godhaniifi miira sodaafi gadda waraanaatiin dhufetti gadhiisanii tasgabbii akka argatan gargaaruuf kan qophaaye dha. Ijoolleen miiliyoona 1.1 ol ta'an rakkoo fayyaa sammuu waan qabaniif, carraan akkanaa kun jireenya idilee akka hubatan isaan gargaara.

title: Usain Bolt’s 100m record broken at World Humanoid Robot Games
english: A Chinese humanoid robot named Lightning has officially surpassed Usain Bolt's 100-meter world record by completing the sprint in 9.32 seconds. Developed by the company Honor, the robot achieved a peak speed of 14.5 meters per second during a testing event in Beijing. This achievement highlights China's rapid advancements in robotics technology and artificial intelligence as they prepare for the second World Humanoid Robot Games.
amharic: ላይትኒንግ የተባለ የቻይና የሰው ቅርጽ ያለው ሮቦት የዩሴይን ቦልትን የ100 ሜትር የዓለም ክብረ ወሰን በ9.32 ሰከንድ በማጠናቀቅ ሰብሮታል። ኦነር በተባለ ኩባንያ የተሰራው ይህ ሮቦት በቤጂንግ በተደረገ የሙከራ ውድድር በሰከንድ 14.5 ሜትር ፍጥነት በመሮጥ አስደናቂ ብቃቱን አሳይቷል። ይህ ውጤት ቻይና በሮቦቲክስ ቴክኖሎጂ እና አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ዘርፍ እያስመዘገበች ያለውን ፈጣን እድገት ያሳያል።
oromo: Roobotni bifa namaa qabu kan Chaayinaa 'Lightning' jedhamu, rekoodii fiigicha meetira 100 kan Usain Bolt seenaa keessatti galmeessise sekondii 9.32tti xumuruun cabseera. Roobotni dhaabbata 'Honor' jedhamuun qophaa'e kun, qophiirra osoo jiruu saffisa meetira 14.5 sekondii tokkotti ga'uun rikoordii kanaan dura ture fooyyessuu danda'eera. Guddinni kun carraaqqii Chaayinaan teeknoolojii roobotiksii fi sammuu namtolchee irratti gochaa jirtu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Over 350,000 people in need of medicines in Gaza: Palestinian Medical Relief Society
english: The Palestinian Medical Relief Society reports that more than 350,000 individuals in Gaza are currently in urgent need of medication. Officials warn that the region's existing medical supplies are completely inadequate to meet the massive demand. Without a significant increase in international aid, the local healthcare system faces a potential collapse.
amharic: የፍልስጤም የህክምና እርዳታ ማህበር እንዳስታወቀው በጋዛ ከ350,000 በላይ ሰዎች አስቸኳይ የመድኃኒት ድጋፍ እንደሚያስፈልጋቸው ተገልጿል። ባለሙያዎች በአካባቢው ያለው የህክምና አቅርቦት ፍላጎቱን ለማሟላት በቂ እንዳልሆነ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ተጨማሪ አለም አቀፍ እርዳታ ካልተገኘ የጤናው ዘርፍ በጣም አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ እንደሚገባ ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Waldaan gargaarsa fayyaa Falasxiin akka ibsetti, namoonni Gaazaa keessa jiran 350,000 ol ta'an qorichi yeroo hatattamaa akka isaan barbaachisu beekameera. Hojjettoonni fayyaa qabeenyi wal'aansaa naannichaa gahaa akka hin taaneefi rakkoon kun yoo itti fufe balaan fayyaa hammatuu akka danda'u akeekkachiisaniiru. Gargaarsi biyyoota alaa hatattamaan yoo dhihaachuu baate, haalli fayyaa naannichaa baay'ee yaaddessaa akka ta'u ibsameera.

title: Ebola continues to spread in the DRC as 16,000 vaccine doses arrive
english: A severe Ebola outbreak is currently spreading through the eastern and northeastern parts of the Democratic Republic of Congo. Health officials report a alarming mortality rate, with one individual losing their life to the virus every half hour. To combat the crisis, 16,000 doses of a vaccine have been delivered to assist in containment efforts.
amharic: በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ምስራቃዊ እና ሰሜን ምስራቅ አካባቢዎች የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየተስፋፋ ይገኛል። የጤና ባለሙያዎች እንደገለጹት በየሰላሳ ደቂቃው አንድ ሰው በቫይረሱ እየሞተ ነው። ይህንን አስከፊ ሁኔታ ለመቆጣጠር እንዲረዳ 16,000 የክትባት መጠን ወደ ሀገሪቱ ደርሷል።
oromo: Vaayirasii Iboola jedhamu kan biyya Koongo kessatti babal'achaa jiru lubbuu namoota hedduu galaafachaa jira. Oddeeffannoon qorannoo fayyaa akka ibsutti, daqiiqaa soddoma soddomatti namni tokko vaayirasichaan du'aa jira. Rakkoo kana dhaabsisuuf ammoo duula talaallii ittisuuf gargaaruuf doozii talaallii kuma 16 ta'u biyyatti galeera.

title: Israeli strike on Palestinian home kills at least one in central Gaza
english: An Israeli military strike targeted a residential building in the city of Deir el-Balah, located in central Gaza. Local medical sources confirmed that at least one individual died and several others were injured in the attack. The Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital is currently treating the victims.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃት በማዕከላዊ ጋዛ በምትገኘው ደይር ኤል-ባላህ ከተማ ውስጥ በሚገኝ አንድ መኖሪያ ቤት ላይ ተፈጽሟል። በአካባቢው የሚገኙ የህክምና ምንጮች እንደገለጹት፣ በደረሰው ጥቃት ቢያንስ አንድ ሰው ህይወቱ አልፏል ሌሎች በርካቶች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሰዎች በአል-አቅሳ ሰማዕታት ሆስፒታል ህክምና እየተደረገላቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el gammoojjii Gaazaa giddu galeessaatti argamtu magaalatti Deeyr el-Balaah keessatti mana jireenyaa tokko irratti haleellaa raawwateera. Maddoonni fayyaa akka mirkaneessanitti, haleellaa kanaan yoo xiqqaate namni tokko lubbuun isaa darbee kanneen biroo baay'een miidhamaniiru. Namoonni miidhaan irra ga'e hospitaala Al-Aqsaa Maartires keessatti yaalamaa jiru.

title: Israel kills at least two Palestinians in Gaza in last 48 hours
english: Israeli military operations in Gaza have resulted in the deaths of two Palestinians and the injury of four others over the past two days. According to Gaza's health authorities, the total number of casualties since the October 2025 ceasefire agreement has climbed to over 1,200 deaths and more than 4,000 injuries. These figures highlight the ongoing violence and the high toll on civilians despite the reported pause in hostilities.
amharic: ባለፉት ሁለት ቀናት በጋዛ በተካሄደው የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ አራት ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። የጋዛ ጤና ጥበቃ ሚኒስቴር እንደገለጸው፣ ከጥቅምት 2025 የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ1,280 በላይ፣ የቆሰሉት ደግሞ ከ4,200 በላይ ደርሷል። ይህ መረጃ ግጭቱ አሁንም ቀጥሎ በሲቪል ህዝቡ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እያደረሰ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Guyyoota lamaan darban keessa humnoonni Israa'el gaazaatti raawwatanin lubbuun namoota Palesxiin lama darbee jirti, afur ammoo madaa'aniiru. Ministeerri fayyaa Gaazaa akka ibsetti, erga ji'a Onkololeessa 2025 waliigalteen dhaabbii waraanaa taasifamee as, namoonni 1,200 ol ajjeefamanii 4,000 ol ammoo madaa'aniiru. Lakkoofsonni kunneen waraanni sun itti fufee miidhaa guddaa namoota nagaa irra gahaa jiru agarsiisu.

title: Israeli drone strike in Syria wounds at least one person
english: An Israeli drone strike recently hit a vehicle in the Syrian village of Beit Jinn, resulting in at least one injury. This incident follows a recent string of military operations conducted by Israel against airbases in Syria. Tensions in the region remain elevated following these repeated attacks.

Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame Israa'el buufataalee waraana Sooriyaa irratti haleellaa walitti aansitee raawwataa turte boodadha. Haleellaa kana hordofee naannichatti waraanniifi tasgabbii dhabuun akka itti fufe ibsameera.

title: US ambassador to Turkey breaks with Washington on Israel's occupation of Syria's Golan Heights
english: The US ambassador to Turkey, Tom Barrack, has publicly disagreed with his government's stance regarding the Golan Heights. While the Trump administration officially recognized Israeli sovereignty over the territory in 2019, Barrack stated that the occupation violates international law and United Nations resolutions. This strategic region remains a point of contention after being captured by Israel during the 1967 war.

oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa gara Tarkii Tom Baaraak, haala lafa Goolaan Hayts ilaalchisee yaada mootummaa isaanii irraa adda ta'e ibsaniiru. Preezdaantiin Ameerikaa bara 2019 qabiyyee Israa'el naannicharratti qabdu beekkamtii kan kennan ta'us, ambaasaaddarichi garuu qabiyyee Israa'el kun seera addunyaafi murtee dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniin kan wal-faallessu ta'uu himaniiru. Naannoon kun Israa'el waraana bara 1967 keessa erga qabattee as, falmisiisaa fi bakka tarsiimawaa ta'ee itti fufeera.

title: Iranian official urges Qatar to move detained pilots to hospital on land, Tasnim says
english: An Iranian official has requested that Qatar relocate several detained pilots from an offshore facility to a hospital, citing their deteriorating health. The official urged the Red Cross to assist in evacuating the men, who have allegedly been held since their plane was shot down during the start of the current conflict. Meanwhile, Qatar has officially rejected these allegations, labeling the claims as inaccurate and misleading.
amharic: አንድ የኢራን ባለስልጣን በኳታር ታስረው የሚገኙ አብራሪዎች የጤና ሁኔታቸው እያሽቆለቆለ በመሆኑ ወደ መሬት ላይ በሚገኝ ሆስፒታል እንዲዛወሩ ጠይቀዋል። ባለስልጣኑ ቀይ መስቀል ታማሚዎቹን ወደ ሀገራቸው ለመመለስ አየር አምቡላንስ እንዲልክ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ኳታር እነዚህን ውንጀላዎች ሙሉ በሙሉ ውድቅ በማድረግ መግለጫዎቹ አሳሳች እንደሆኑ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Iran qondaalonni Qatar bakka bishaan gubbaa isaan qaban keessatti fayyaan isaanii waan xiqqaateef, gara hospitaala lafa irraatti akka isaan dabarsan gaafataniiru. Qondaalichi qaqqabaa fannoo diimaa fayyadamuun namoota dhukkubsatan kana gara Iran akka deebisan gaafate. Qatar garuu himannaa kana guutummaatti kan haalte yoo ta'u, ibsi kun dhuga irraa kan fagaate fi dogoggorsaa akka ta'e ibsiteetti.

title: Mecca Agreement: A Muslim Nato or yet another Baghdad Pact?
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, a pact that mirrors historical US-backed regional alliances designed to protect Western interests. While some interpret this as a move toward greater independence or a stance against Israel, experts view it as a continuation of long-standing US strategy to align regional powers against common adversaries. This coalition resembles the 1950s Baghdad Pact, intended to secure pro-Western regimes and maintain US geopolitical influence in the Middle East.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን የምዕራባውያንን ፍላጎት ለማስጠበቅ የታለመውን የመካ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ስምምነቱ እንደ አዲስ የነጻነት እርምጃ ወይም በእስራኤል ላይ የተቃጣ ጥምረት ተደርጎ ቢወሰድም፣ ተንታኞች ግን ይህ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የረጅም ጊዜ ስልት አካል መሆኑን ይገልጻሉ። ይህ ጥምረት በ1950ዎቹ የነበረውን 'የባግዳድ ስምምነት' የሚያስታውስ ሲሆን፣ ዓላማውም በክልሉ ውስጥ የአሜሪካን ተጽዕኖ ለማጠናከር እና የምዕራባውያን አጋር የሆኑ መንግስታትን ለመጠበቅ ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaa, Turkii fi Paakistaan waliigaltee ittisa biyyaa kan Makkaa mallatteessaniiru; kunis fedhii fi faayidaa biyyoota dhihaa eeguuf kan qophaaye dha. Waliigalteen kun akka tarkaanfii of danda'uu ykn dhaabbata Israa'el irratti xiyyeeffatuutti kan ilaalamu ta'us, ogeeyyiin garuu kun imaammata Ameerikaa kan bara dheeraa kan diinota waliinii irratti xiyyeeffatu ta'uu ibsu. Gamtaan kun waliigaltee bara 1950otaa kan 'Baagdaad Paakt' jedhamu wajjin kan walfakkaatu yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas dhiibbaa Ameerikaa naannichatti jabeessee fi mootummoota dhihaa deggeran eeguu dha.

title: More than 16,000 doses of Ervebo vaccine arrive in Ebola-hit DR Congo
english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has received over 16,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine to help combat a severe and rapidly spreading Ebola outbreak. While these vaccines were designed for a different strain of the virus, health officials hope they will provide some protection and are planning clinical trials to test their effectiveness. Efforts to control the disease are currently being complicated by regional armed conflict and significant infrastructure challenges.
amharic: የኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ በፍጥነት እየተስፋፋ ያለውን የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ለመከላከል ከ16,000 በላይ የኤርቬቦ ክትባት መጠን ተረክባለች። እነዚህ ክትባቶች የተዘጋጁት ለሌላ የቫይረሱ ዝርያ ቢሆንም፣ የጤና ባለሙያዎች የተወሰነ ጥበቃ እንደሚሰጡ ተስፋ በማድረግ ውጤታማነታቸውን ለመፈተሽ የክሊኒካል ሙከራዎችን ለማድረግ አቅደዋል። ወረርሽኙን ለመቆጣጠር የሚደረገው ጥረት በአካባቢው በሚካሄደው ግጭት እና በሰፊው የመሰረተ ልማት ችግሮች ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ፈተና ገጥሞታል።
oromo: Jamhuuriyya Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti dhibeen Ebola saffisaan babal'achaa jiru to'achuuf talaallii Ervebo doozii 16,000 ol ta'u fudhatteetti. Talaallin kun kan hojjetame gosa vaayirasii biraatiif ta'us, ogeeyyiin fayyaa ittisa tokko akka kennu abdatanii fi bu'a qabeessummaa isaa qorachuuf qorannoo yaalii fayyaa gochuuf karoorfataniiru. Carraaqqiin dhibee kana to'achuuf godhamaa jiru walitti bu'iinsa hidhattootaa fi rakkoolee bu'uuraalee misoomaa jiraan irraa kan ka'e gufuun itti ta'aa jira.

title: Pakistan’s PTI seeks contempt action over jailed Imran Khan’s hospital move
english: Imran Khan's political party has filed a contempt of court petition against Pakistani government officials for failing to follow a directive to transfer the former prime minister to a private hospital. Although the court ordered treatment at a specific private facility, authorities instead took Khan to a government hospital for a brief check-up before returning him to jail. The party argues this violates judicial orders and denies Khan access to his own doctors, while the government maintains the move was based on security concerns.

oromo: Paartiin isaanii kan durii muummicha ministeera Paakistaan Imraan Kaan, mootummaan ajaja mana murtii kabajuu diduun isaatti aaruun himata bananiiru. Paartiin isaanii gochi kun ajaja mana murtii cabsuu fi ogeeyyiin fayyaa isaa akka isa hin argine dhorkuu dha jedhee kan falmu yoo ta'u, mootummaan garuu tarkaanfichi kan fudhatame sababa nageenyaatiin jedheera.

title: Manchester City preview: Five key questions heading into 2026-27 season
english: Manchester City is entering a new era as Enzo Maresca takes over as manager following the departure of Pep Guardiola, who defined the club's most successful decade. The team faces significant pressure to maintain its dominance after a disappointing loss in the Community Shield and the departure of star midfielder Rodri to Barcelona. While the club has signed Elliot Anderson to bolster the midfield, fans and analysts are eager to see if Maresca can successfully manage expectations and implement his own identity while building on Guardiola's legacy.

oromo: Pep Guardiola waggoota kudhaniif garee kana gaggeessaa erga turee booda gadi lakkisee ba'uun, Manchester City gara jijjiirama haaraatti seenteetti. Enzo Maresca bakka bu'uun isaa fi taphataan giddu galeessaan murteessaan Rodri gara Barcelona deemun isaa, qophii irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumeera. Gareen kun Elliot Anderson itti dabaluun cimina isaa eeggachuuf yaalaa yoo ta'u, Maresca dandeettii isaa fayyadamee hojii cimaa Guardiola booda dhufe kana milkeessuu danda'a moo miti kan jedhu gaaffii guddaa ta'eera.

title: Former world champion boxer Zolani Tete shot and killed in South Africa
english: Former world boxing champion Zolani Tete was fatally shot by two masked assailants outside his home in the Eastern Cape, South Africa. The 38-year-old athlete was sitting in his car when the attack occurred, which also left a 27-year-old woman hospitalized with multiple gunshot wounds. Tete, known for achieving the fastest knockout in a world title fight, was in the process of planning a professional comeback following the end of a suspension.
