oromo: Qondaaltoota mootummaa fi qabsaa'ota ispoortii biyyattii akka ibsanitti, waldhaansoo boksiin kan beekamu fi injifataa addunyaa duraanii Zolani Tete, naannoo Eastern Cape kanatti nama harka lamaan hidhatanii fi fuula isaanii haguuggataniin ajjeefameera. Tete yeroo balaan kun isa mudatu konkolaataa isaa keessa ture; dubartiin isaa wajjin turtes miidhaan guddaan irra ga'ee hospitaala ciisiti. Tete seenaa ispoortii keessatti injifannoo saffisaa galmeessisuun kan beekamu yoo ta'u, erga dhorkaan isa irra turee darbee booda gara ispoortiitti deebi'uuf qophiirra ture.

title: Iran says new US sanctions violate sovereignty of other states
english: Iran has condemned new US threats of economic sanctions, calling them a violation of international sovereignty and a return to colonial-era practices. President Trump recently warned that any nation continuing to conduct business with Tehran would face severe financial consequences. Iranian officials dismissed these measures as ineffective, arguing that such policies undermine the foundations of the global order while insisting that the country remains resilient against these familiar tactics.
amharic: ኢራን አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የምትጥለው አዲስ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ የሌሎች አገሮችን ሉዓላዊነት የሚጥስ እና ወደ ቅኝ ግዛት ዘመን የሚመልስ ነው ስትል ኮንናለች። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነት የሚያደርጉ ሀገራት ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ቅጣት እንደሚጠብቃቸው አስጠንቅቀዋል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ማዕቀቡ ውጤት አልባ እንደሚሆን በመግለጽ፣ ይህም አሜሪካ የአለም አቀፍ ስርዓቱን መሰረት እየሸረሸረች መሆኑን ያሳያል ብለዋል።
oromo: Iiraan tarkaanfii diinagdee haarawa Ameerikaan ishee irratti fudhattu kanneen biyyoota biraa kan miidhuu fi gara bara koloneeffataa kan deebisu ta'uu ibsitee balaaleffatteetti. Preezdaant Traamp, biyyoota Iiraan waliin daldala itti fufan irratti tarkaanfii cimaa kan fudhatan ta'uu akeekkachiisaniiru. Bulchiinsi Iiraan tarkaanfiin kun bu'aa kan hin qabne fi Ameerikaan hundee sirna idil-addunyaa mancaasaa akka jirtu dubbachuun, kanneen akka hin hojjenne ibsaniiru.

title: Australia bite back as 18 wickets fall on day one of second Bangladesh Test
english: The second Test match between Australia and Bangladesh saw a dramatic opening day with 18 wickets falling as bowlers dominated. Australia dismissed Bangladesh for just 64 runs behind a stellar performance by Mitchell Starc, who took six wickets. In response, Bangladesh's Shoriful Islam also claimed six wickets to leave the Australian side at 165-8 by the end of the day.
amharic: በአውስትራሊያ እና በባንግላዲሽ መካከል እየተካሄደ ባለው ሁለተኛው የሙከራ የክሪኬት ጨዋታ የመጀመሪያ ቀን 18 ውድቀቶች በማስተናገድ ከፍተኛ የኳስ ተጫዋቾች የበላይነት ታይቶበታል። አውስትራሊያ ሚቸል ስታርክ በወሰዳቸው ስድስት ውድቀቶች ታግዛ ባንግላዲሽን በ64 ነጥብ ብቻ መቆጣጠር ችላለች። ሆኖም በምላሹ የባንግላዲሹ ሾሪፉል እስላም እንዲሁ ስድስት ተጫዋቾችን በማውጣት የአውስትራሊያን ቡድን በ165 ለ 8 ላይ እንዲገደብ አድርጓል።
oromo: Tapha kirikeetii isa lammaffaa Awustiraaliyaa fi Baangilaadish gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru guyyaa tokkoffaa isaa irratti gadi bu'iinsi wickets 18 waan tureef guyyaa baay'ee ajaa'ibsiisaa ture. Awustiraaliyaan taphattoota ishee Miichel Staarkiin kan gargaaramte yoo ta'u, Baangilaadishin qabxii 64 qofa irratti dhaabuu dandeesseetti. Garuu, deebiin Baangilaadish kan ture Shoriful Islaam wickets 6 fudhachuun gareen Awustiraaliyaa guyyicha qabxii 165 wickets 8 irratti akka xumuraniif dirqisiiseera.

title: Muslim World League denounces new Israeli E1 settlement tender
english: The Muslim World League has officially criticized Israel's plan to build over 1,200 new housing units in the West Bank's E1 region. The organization warned that this project undermines the possibility of a future Palestinian state by changing the area's population and borders. Leaders are now urging the international community to intervene to stop these settlement activities and protect the two-state solution.
amharic: የሙስሊም ዓለም ሊግ በእስራኤል የተያዘው ምዕራብ ባንክ ውስጥ ከ1,200 በላይ አዳዲስ የመኖሪያ ቤቶችን ለመገንባት የተወሰነውን ውሳኔ በይፋ አውግዟል። ድርጅቱ ይህ ፕሮጀክት በክልሉ ያለውን ስብጥር እና መልክ በመቀየር ለፍልስጤም ነፃ መንግሥት ምስረታ ትልቅ ስጋት እንደሚፈጥር አስጠንቅቋል። ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብም ይህንን ሰፈራ ለማስቆም እና የሁለት መንግሥታት መፍትሄን ለመጠበቅ ጫና እንዲፈጥር ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Liigii Addunyaa Musliimaa, Israa'el naannoo Qaqqabaa Lixaa keessatti mana jireenyaa 1,200 ol ijaaruuf karoorfatte cimsee balaaleffateera. Dhaabbatichi karoori kun uummataafi bifa lafa naannichaa jijjiiruun biyyoolummaa Falasxiin irratti rakkoo guddaa akka uumu ibseera. Kanaafuu, hawaasni addunyaa hojii qubannaa kana dhaabsisuufi furmaata biyya lamaa akka eeguuf gaafateera.

title: Nakashima pounds Fritz, Bejlek beats Keys in Cincinnati upsets
english: Brandon Nakashima achieved a major upset by defeating Taylor Fritz to reach the Cincinnati Masters semifinals, where he will face Frances Tiafoe. On the women's side, Sara Bejlek continued her impressive run by overcoming Madison Keys, setting up a semifinal match against Coco Gauff. These results highlight significant shifts in the tournament standings shortly before the upcoming US Open.
amharic: ብራንደን ናካሺማ ታይለር ፍሪትዝን በማሸነፍ ወደ ሲንሲናቲ ማስተርስ ግማሽ ፍፃሜ ማለፉን ተከትሎ ከፍራንሲስ ቲያፎ ጋር ይፋጠጣል። በሴቶች ምድብ ደግሞ ሳራ ቤይሌክ ማዲሰን ኪስን በማሸነፍ ወደ ቀጣዩ ዙር በመግባት ከኮኮ ጋፍ ጋር ለመጫወት ተዘጋጅታለች። እነዚህ ውጤቶች የአሜሪካ ክፍት የቴኒስ ውድድር ከመጀመሩ ጥቂት ቀናት ቀደም ብሎ በውድድሩ ላይ ትልቅ መነቃቃትን ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Birandon Naakashiiman Tapha Siinsiinaatii Maastars irratti Teeylar Firitziin injifachuun gara giddu-galeessa xumuraatti darbeera; achittis Fireensis Tiyafoon wal-morkatu. Garee dubartootaatiin immoo, Saaraa Bejleek Maadiisan Kiisiin injifachuun gara walakkaa xumuraatti darbuu ishee hordofee, Koorkoo Gaafiin waliin wal-morkatu. Bu'aawwan kun dorgommii 'US Open' jalqabamuuf jiru dura guddina guddaa agarsiisaniiru.

title: How will Trump’s tariffs affect Canada’s economy?
english: The United States has implemented a 50 percent tariff on $20 billion worth of Canadian products following the failure of recent trade negotiations. While experts do not expect these measures to destroy the Canadian economy entirely, the taxes will likely place significant financial pressure on vital industries. This move has caused a major increase in political and economic friction between the two neighboring countries.
amharic: የንግድ ድርድር ባለመሳካቱ ምክንያት አሜሪካ በካናዳ ምርቶች ላይ የ50 በመቶ ቀረጥ ጣለች። ይህ እርምጃ በካናዳ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ሙሉ በሙሉ መፈራረስ አያመጣም ተብሎ ቢጠበቅም፣ በዋና ዋና የኢኮኖሚ ዘርፎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና ይፈጥራል። ይህ ውሳኔ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን የንግድ አለመግባባት እንዲባባስ አድርጓል።
oromo: Hirmaannaan daldalaa akka tasaa waan dhaabateef, Ameerikaan meeshaalee Kaanaadaa gatii dolaara biiliyoona 20 baasanii irratti gibira dhibbeentaa 50 ta'u kaffalchiisuu eegalteetti. Akka ogeeyyiin jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun diinagdee Kaanaadaa guutummaatti kan diigu ta'uu baatus, dameewwan diinagdee ijoo irratti miidhaa guddaa qaqqabsiisuu danda'a. Murtiin kun walitti dhufeenya daldalaa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan hammeesse dha.

title: Panama Canal to reduce shipping as ‘extreme’ El Nino approaches
english: The Panama Canal authority is decreasing the number of daily ship transits to manage lower water levels caused by an upcoming severe El Nino season. Starting in September, transit limits will be reduced in stages to conserve water resources. This bottleneck is expected to create shipping delays and potentially increase operational costs for businesses that depend on the canal.
amharic: የፓናማ ካናል አስተዳደር በኤል ኒኖ የአየር ንብረት ክስተት ምክንያት የሚጠበቀውን የውሃ መጠን መቀነስ ለመቋቋም የሚያልፉ መርከቦችን ቁጥር እየቀነሰ ነው። ከሴፕቴምበር ወር ጀምሮ የሚተገበረው ይህ ገደብ፣ የውሃ ሀብትን ለመቆጠብ በማሰብ ቀስ በቀስ የሚቀንስ ይሆናል። ይህ ለውጥ በካናሉ ላይ ጥገኛ በሆኑ የንግድ ዘርፎች ላይ መዘግየቶችን እና የወጪ ጭማሪን ሊያስከትል እንደሚችል ተሰግቷል።
oromo: Humni bulchiinsa daandii bishaan Panamaa, sababa jijjiirama qilleensa 'El Nino' tiin sadarkaan bishaanichaa hir’achuu waan maluuf, guyyaatti dooniiwwan darban xiqqeessuuf murteesseera. Jijjiiramni kun gara garaa bara kanaa keessa kan raawwatamu yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas qabeenya bishaanii qusachuu dha. Haalli kun imala dooniiwwanii irratti gufuu uumee, daldaltoota daandii kana fayyadamaniif gatiin waraqaa baasii akka dabalu gochuu danda'a.

title: Tehran says Iraqi oil tankers allowed passage through Hormuz
english: Iran has granted permission for Iraqi oil tankers to travel through the Strait of Hormuz. This decision followed a formal request made by Iraq's parliamentary speaker to his Iranian counterpart during an official visit. The move highlights the ongoing diplomatic coordination between the two nations regarding regional maritime transit.
amharic: ኢራን የኢራቅ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከቦች በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል እንዲያልፉ ፈቃድ ሰጥታለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው የኢራቅ የፓርላማ አፈ-ጉባኤ በኢራን ባደረጉት ጉብኝት ወቅት ለኢራን አቻቸው ባቀረቡት ጥያቄ መሰረት ነው። ድርጊቱ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል በክልሉ የባህር ጉዞ ላይ ያለውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ትብብር ያሳያል።
oromo: Iiraan dooniiwwan boba'aa Iraaq daandii Hormuz qaxxaamuranii akka darban hayyamteetti. Murtoon kun kan darbe, afaan-gaaffiin paarlamaa Iraaq gaaffii inni gara Iiraanitti imale irratti akka dhiyeesse hordofuudha. Tarkaanfiin kun hariiroo diippilomaasii biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan ibsuudha.

title: Exclusive: UK's advertising regulator not investigating Great Israeli Real Estate Event
english: The UK’s Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) has decided not to investigate a real estate event held in London that promoted properties located in illegal Israeli settlements. Although government ministers formally requested an urgent inquiry following reports that such properties were being marketed, the regulator claims it lacks the necessary complaints to launch a formal investigation. While the event's organizers later admitted to promoting these properties, the ASA maintains that it requires specific evidence to take action.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የማስታወቂያ ተቆጣጣሪ ባለሥልጣን (ASA) በለንደን ተካሂዶ በነበረ እና በሕገ-ወጥ የእስራኤል ሰፈራዎች ውስጥ የሚገኙ ንብረቶችን ባስተዋወቀ የሪል እስቴት ዝግጅት ላይ ምርመራ ላለማድረግ ወስኗል። የመንግሥት ሚኒስትሮች ዝግጅቱ ሕገ-ወጥ የሪል እስቴት ማስታወቂያዎችን አቅርቧል በሚል አስቸኳይ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ ጥያቄ ቢያቀርቡም፣ ተቆጣጣሪው ተገቢውን ቅሬታ ስላልደረሰው ምርመራ መጀመር እንደማይችል ገልጿል። የዝግጅቱ አዘጋጆች ንብረቶቹን በስህተት እንዳስተዋወቁ ቢቀበሉም፣ የኤስኤ (ASA) ተቋም እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ተጨማሪ ማስረጃ እንደሚያስፈልገው አስታውቋል።
oromo: Abbaan taayitaa biiroo gabaasaa (ASA) kan UK, London keessatti qophii mana jireenyaa kanneen naannoo qubannaa Israa'el seeraan alaa keessatti argaman beeksisu irratti qorannoo akka hin gaggeessine murteesseera. Ministiroonni mootummaa, qophiin kun beeksisa seeraan alaa dhiheesseera jechuun qorannoo ariifachiisaa akka gaggeeffamu gaafatanis, abbaan taayitaachi himanni gahaa hin dhiyaanneef jechuun qorannoo hin jalqabne. Gurmeessitoonni qophiichaa qabeenya kanneen dogoggoraan beeksisuu isaanii erga amanii boodas, ASA tarkaanfii fudhachuuf ragaa dabalataa akka barbaadu ibseera.

title: Lebanon economy to contract by 6.4 percent due to war, World Bank says
english: The World Bank predicts Lebanon's economy will shrink by 6.4 percent this year due to the ongoing conflict, which has hindered recent recovery efforts. This decline is largely caused by the collapse of tourism, supply chain issues, and increased regional insecurity. Additionally, high inflation is expected to further decrease the purchasing power of residents, though experts stress that implementing financial reforms remains essential for long-term stability.
amharic: የዓለም ባንክ ባወጣው ሪፖርት መሠረት፣ በሊባኖስ እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት የአገሪቱን የኢኮኖሚ እድገት በማስተጓጎሉ በዘንድሮው ዓመት ኢኮኖሚው በ6.4 በመቶ እንዲቀንስ ይጠበቃል። ይህ የኢኮኖሚ መቀዛቀዝ የቱሪዝም ዘርፉ መውደም፣ የዕቃዎች አቅርቦት መስተጓጎል እና የኑሮ ውድነት ተጽዕኖ የተፈጠረ ነው። ባለሙያዎች እንደገለጹት፣ አገሪቱ ከቀውሱ ለመውጣት የባንክ እና የፋይናንስ ማሻሻያዎችን በአስቸኳይ መተግበር ይኖርባታል።
oromo: Baankiin Addunyaa akka gabaasetti, waraana biyyattii keessatti adeemaa jiruun walqabatee dinagdeen Libanon bara kana dhibbeentaa 6.4 irra ga'uun akka hir'atu raajii dubbateera. Hir'inni dinagdee kun kan mudate sababa dameen turizmii miidhamuu, dhiyeessiin meeshaalee adda cituu fi gatiin jireenyaa olka'uudhaani. Rakkoo kana keessaa ba'uuf, biyyattiin guddina dinagdee ishee deebistee ijaaruuf carraaqqii fi jijjiirama caasolee faayinaansii irratti xiyyeeffachuu akka qabdu gorsameera.

title: Morning recap
english: US President Donald Trump has asserted that the Strait of Hormuz is American territory and insists that Iran must be prevented from acquiring nuclear weapons. In response, Iranian officials have condemned new US sanctions as a declaration of war that is destined to fail. Meanwhile, regional tensions remain high, with ongoing Israeli military operations in Lebanon and Syria, alongside significant disruptions to commercial shipping in the Middle East.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን የአሜሪካ ግዛት እንደሆኑ በመግለጽ ኢራን የኒውክሌር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ መከላከል እንደሚያስፈልግ አሳስበዋል። ለዚህ ምላሽ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በአሜሪካ የተጣለባቸውን ማዕቀብ የጦርነት አዋጅ ነው በማለት ውድቅ አድርገውታል። በሌላ በኩል በእስራኤል እና በአጎራባች ሀገራት ያለው ወታደራዊ ውጥረት የቀጠለ ሲሆን በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የንግድ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ ላይም ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል ታይቷል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp daandiin galaana Hormuz kan Ameerikaati jechuun, Iraan meeshaa niwukilaraa akka hin arganne dhorguun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Iraanis tarkaanfii Ameerikaan fudhatte kana akka labsi waraanaatti kan fudhatte yoo ta'u, milkaa'ina akka hin qabaanne dubbatteetti. Gamtaan biroon, waraansi Israa'el biyyoota ollaa keessatti itti fufee jiruu fi geejjiba meeshaalee gurguddaa irratti dhiibbaan uumamee jira.

title: Israeli forces shell towns in southern Lebanon, continue demolitions
english: Israeli military forces have conducted a series of artillery strikes and airstrikes across various locations in southern Lebanon. Additionally, the military has engaged in widespread demolition operations that have caused significant destruction to residential areas in multiple villages. Drones have also been observed patrolling the skies over the region as these aggressive operations continue.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ላይ ተከታታይ የጦር መሳሪያ እና የአየር ጥቃቶችን አድርሰዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ ወታደሮቹ በበርካታ መንደሮች ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ውድመት ያስከተሉ ሰፊ የህንፃዎች የማፍረስ ስራዎችን አከናውነዋል። እነዚህ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች በሚቀጥሉበት ወቅት ድሮኖች በክልሉ ሰማይ ላይ በተደጋጋሚ ሲታዩ ቆይተዋል።
oromo: Humnootiin waraana Israa'eel kibba Libanon keessatti iddoowwan garaagaraatti rukuttaa boombii fi qilleensarraa gaggeessaniiru. Kana malees, waraanni kun ganda hedduu keessatti mana jireenyaa fi qabeenya barbadeessuudhaan diiggaa guddaa raawwateera. Gochootni waraanaa kun osoo itti fufanii jiruu, xiyyaarotni nama hin feene (drones) samii naannichaa irra yeroo hunda balali'aa akka turan gabaafameera.

title: Lionel Messi fined for striking opponent in Inter Miami MLS game
english: Major League Soccer has issued an undisclosed fine to Lionel Messi for making contact with an opponent's head during a recent match against the Philadelphia Union. His teammate, Ian Fray, received a similar penalty for the same rule violation during the same game. Meanwhile, the league overturned a red card previously given to Philadelphia's Cavan Sullivan, allowing him to return to play.
amharic: የሜጀር ሊግ ሶከር (MLS) ሊዮኔል ሜሲ ከፊላደልፊያ ዩኒየን ጋር በተደረገው ጨዋታ ወቅት ተጋጣሚውን በመምታቱ ያልተገለጸ የገንዘብ ቅጣት አስተላልፎበታል። በተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ የኢንተር ማያሚው ተከላካይ ኢያን ፍሬም ተመሳሳይ ህግ በመተላለፉ ቅጣት ተጥሎበታል። በሌላ በኩል ሊጉ ቀደም ብሎ ለፊላደልፊያው ካቫን ሱሊቫን የሰጠውን የቀይ ካርድ ውሳኔ በመሻር ወደ ሜዳ እንዲመለስ ፈቅዷል።
oromo: Ajajni dhimmota angoo MLS Lionel Messi tapha Philadelphia Union wajjin godhame irratti mormituu isaa irratti harka kaasuun seera cabsuu isaatiin adabbii maallaqaa isa mudateera. Hiriyaan isaa Ian Fray’n dogoggora walfakkaataa raawwachuun isaa adabbiin kan irratti murame yoo ta'u, gama biraatiin, sagantaan kun Cavan Sullivan irratti kennamee ture haqamee taphataan kun tapha itti aanu irratti akka hirmaatu ta'eera.

title: ‘Young want to leave’: Libya’s brain drain, 15 years after Tripoli fell
english: Fifteen years after the fall of Muammar Gaddafi, Libya continues to face a significant brain drain as many educated young professionals choose to live and work abroad. Individuals like architect Sarah Mizran and media entrepreneur Nader Elgadi left the country due to ongoing conflict, instability, and limited career opportunities. These professionals feel that returning home is currently unfeasible, which further weakens the nation's hope for future development.
amharic: ሙአመር ጋዳፊ ከስልጣን ከተወገዱ አስራ አምስት አመታት በኋላ፣ ሊቢያ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የሰለጠኑ የሰው ኃይል ፍልሰት እያጋጠማት ትገኛለች። እንደ አርክቴክት ሳራ ሚዝራን እና የብዙኃን መገናኛ ባለሙያ ናደር ኤልጋዲ ያሉ ወጣቶች በሀገሪቱ ባለው አለመረጋጋት እና በቂ የስራ ዕድል አለመኖር ምክንያት ወደ ውጭ ሀገራት ተሰደዋል። እነዚህ ባለሙያዎች ወደ ሀገራቸው ለመመለስ አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ በመሆናቸው፣ ይህም ለሊቢያ የወደፊት እድገት ትልቅ ተግዳሮት ሆኗል።
oromo: Mu’ammar Gadaafii erga aangoo irraa bu’anii waggaa kudha shan booda, Liibiyaan ogummaa qaban biyyaa baqachuu isaatiin miidhaa cimaa keessa jirti. Akka saaraa Miizraanii fi Naader Elgaadii kanneen jiran beektonni fi ogeeyyiin hedduun rakkoo nageenyaa fi carraa hojii dhabuun walqabatee biyyaa baqatanii jiru. Ogeeyyiin kun biyyatti deebi’uun ammaaf akka hin danda’amne waan amananiif, kun ammoo abdii gara fuulduraa kan biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa uumee jira.

title: World Bank projects war-hit Lebanon’s economy to contract by 6.4 percent
english: The World Bank reports that Lebanon's economy is expected to shrink by 6.4 percent this year due to the ongoing conflict with Israel. The fighting has damaged vital infrastructure, displaced many citizens, and severely hampered key sectors like tourism and trade. To stabilize the country, the report emphasizes the urgent need for financial reforms and the restructuring of the banking sector.
amharic: የዓለም ባንክ ባወጣው ሪፖርት መሠረት፣ በእስራኤል እና በሊባኖስ መካከል ያለው ግጭት በፈጠረው ተጽዕኖ የሊባኖስ ኢኮኖሚ በዘንድሮው ዓመት በ6.4 በመቶ እንደሚያሽቆለቁል ተገልጿል። ግጭቱ የመሠረተ ልማት አውታሮችን በመጉዳቱ፣ በርካታ ዜጎችን በማፈናቀሉ እና የቱሪዝም ዘርፉን በማቀዛቀዙ በኢኮኖሚው ላይ ከባድ ጫና ፈጥሯል። ሀገሪቱ የተረጋጋ ኢኮኖሚ ለመገንባት እንዲቻል በአስቸኳይ የባንክ ሥርዓቱን ማሻሻል እና ተገቢውን የኢኮኖሚ ለውጥ ማድረግ እንዳለባትም ተመልክቷል።
oromo: Baankiin Addunyaa akka gabaasetti, waraana Israa'elii fi Liibaanoos gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiruun diinagdeen Liibaanoos bara kana dhibbeentaa 6.4 gad bu'uun isaa ni tilmaamama. Waraanichi bu'uuraalee misoomaa miidhuu fi namoota baay'ee buqqisuu isaatiin alatti, damee tuurizimii fi daldala irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumeera. Biyyi kun diinagdee ishee tasgabbeessuuf, sirna baankii fooyyeessuu fi jijjiirama diinagdee barbaachisaa ta'e ariitiin raawwachuu akka qabdu gabaasichi akeekkachiiseera.

title: Somalia child hunger crisis deepens after aid cuts, UNICEF says
english: Somalia is facing a worsening humanitarian crisis as international aid cuts have forced the closure of numerous health and nutrition centers. UNICEF reports a significant increase in children suffering from severe malnutrition, with nearly two million children expected to be affected this year. Ongoing drought, rising costs, and reduced funding have severely restricted access to essential services for the country's most vulnerable people.
amharic: በሶማሊያ የዓለም አቀፍ ዕርዳታ በመቀነሱ ሳቢያ በርካታ የጤና እና የአመጋገብ ማዕከላት በመዘጋታቸው የሰብዓዊ ቀውሱ እየተባባሰ ይገኛል። የዩኒሴፍ መረጃ እንደሚያሳየው በከፍተኛ የምግብ እጥረት የሚሰቃዩ ሕፃናት ቁጥር በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምሯል፤ በዚህ ዓመትም ወደ ሁለት ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ሕፃናት ለአደጋው የተጋለጡ ናቸው። የድርቅ፣ የኑሮ ውድነት እና የገንዘብ እጥረት ጥምረት በሀገሪቱ ያሉ ተጋላጭ ዜጎች መሰረታዊ አገልግሎቶችን እንዳያገኙ አድርጓል።
oromo: Somaliyaa keessatti gargaarsi idil-addunyaa hir'achuu isaatiin wal-qabatee, buufataaleen fayyaa fi nyaata kennan hedduun cufamuun rakkoon nam-tolchee hammaachaa jira. UNICEF akka gabaasetti, daa'imman hanqina nyaata cimaan miidhaman dabaluu isaanii fi bara kana daa'imman miliyoona lamaan kan lakkaa'aman rakkoo kanaaf saaxilamuu isaanii ibse. Kuni hundi, rakkoo hongee, gatii wantootaa dabaluu fi gargaarsi hir'achuun wal-qabatee jiraattota biyyattii rakkoo keessa jiranif tajaajila barbaachisaa ta'e dhabsiiseera.

title: Lindsay Clancy suffering 'command hallucination' when she killed children, court hears
english: During the trial of Lindsay Clancy, who is accused of killing her three children, a forensic psychiatrist testified that she was experiencing severe postpartum psychosis at the time. The defense argues she suffered from command hallucinations and delusions, making her unable to understand the wrongfulness of her actions. While prosecutors claim the killings were calculated, the defense maintains she was experiencing a mental health crisis that prevented her from controlling her behavior.
amharic: ሶስት ልጆቿን በመግደል የተከሰሰችው ሊንዚ ክላንሲ በችሎት ላይ በነበረችበት ወቅት ከባድ የወሊድ ድባቴ (postpartum psychosis) እንደነበረባት የፎረንሲክ ሳይካትሪስት አስረድተዋል። መከላከያዋ ክላንሲ ድርጊቱን የፈጸመችው የውስጥ ድምፆች በሚያዙት ትዕዛዝ መሰረት መሆኑን እና በወቅቱ የራሷን ድርጊት መቆጣጠር እንደማትችል ተናግረዋል። አቃቤ ህግ ግድያው የታቀደ መሆኑን ቢከራከርም፣ መከላከያ በኩል ግን የአእምሮ ህመሟ የመወሰን አቅሟን እንደነፈጋት በማስረጃ አስደግፈዋል።
oromo: Mucoolii ishee sadan ajjeeste jedhamtee kan himatamte Lindsay Clancy, yeroo yakka sana raawwattetti dhukkuba sammuu cimaa kan daa'ima deessuu booda dhufuun miidhamtee akka turte ogeessi sammuu ragaa ba'eera. Manni murtii himannoo ishee irratti xiyyeeffachaa jiru yeroo ammaa kana, himatamtuun sammuun ishee guutummaatti too'annoo ishee ala ta'ee turuu isaa ragaaleen dhihaatan agarsiisu. Abbaan alangaa tarkaanfichi kan karoorfame ture jedhee himatus, gartuun ishee immoo rakkoo fayyaa sammuu isheetiin kan ka'e murtoo sirrii gochuu akka hin dandeenye falmataa jira.

title: China’s new moon mission could unlock secret of lunar ice: Why that matters
english: China is preparing to launch the Chang’e-7 mission, a robotic space project aimed at discovering ice water located in the permanently shadowed craters of the moon's south pole. This mission is highly significant because finding accessible lunar water could provide essential resources for future human crews. Furthermore, studying this ice may reveal critical scientific information about the history of the moon and the origins of water in our solar system.
amharic: ቻይና የቻንግ-ኢ-7 የተሰኘ የጠፈር ምርምር ተልዕኮ ወደ ጨረቃ ደቡብ ዋልታ ለመላክ ዝግጅቷን አጠናቃለች። የዚህ ተልዕኮ ዋና ዓላማ ጨረቃ ላይ በሚገኙ ጥቁር እና ለፀሐይ ብርሃን በማይደርሱባቸው ጉድጓዶች ውስጥ ያለውን በረዶ መመርመር ነው። በጨረቃ ላይ ውሃ መኖሩን ማረጋገጥ ለወደፊት የሰው ልጅ የጠፈር ጉዞዎች መጠጥና ነዳጅ ለማግኘት ትልቅ ፋይዳ አለው። በተጨማሪም ይህ በረዶ ስለ ጨረቃ አመጣጥ እና ስለ ስርዓተ ፀሐይ ታሪክ ጠቃሚ የሳይንስ መረጃዎችን ይዞ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ይታመናል።
oromo: Chaayinaan ergama haaraa 'Chang'e-7' jedhamu kan roobootii of keessaa qabu gara ji'aatti erguuf qophiirra jirti. Kaayyoon ergama kanaa laga ji'aa keessatti lafa ifni hin geenye fi gaaddisa keessa jiran keessatti bishaan ykn cabbii barbaaduu dha. Bishaan ji'aarratti argamu kun gara fuulduraatti namoota gara ji'aatti imalanif bishaan dhugaatii fi qabeenya barbaachisaa ta'uu danda'a. Kana malees, qorannoon kun waa'ee seenaa ji'aatii fi akkaataa bishaan sirna aduu keessatti uumame hubachuuf gargaara.

title: ‘It was a tsunami’: Floods leave death trail in India’s Assam
english: Severe monsoon flooding in India’s Assam state has caused catastrophic damage after heavy rains triggered river surges and landslides. The disaster has claimed over 100 lives, destroyed thousands of homes, and displaced hundreds of thousands of people. Many families, such as that of Debiram Panika, are left grieving as they search for missing loved ones amidst the ruins of their villages.
amharic: በሕንድ አሳም ግዛት የጣለው ከባድ የዝናብ መጠን በፈጠረው ድንገተኛ ጎርፍ እና የመሬት መንሸራተት ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሷል። በአደጋው ከ100 በላይ ሰዎች ሕይወታቸውን ያጡ ሲሆን፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤቶች በመውደማቸው እና በመቶ ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች በመፈናቀላቸው ሰብአዊ ቀውስ ተፈጥሯል። እንደ ዴቢራም ፓኒካ ያሉ ተጎጂዎች በጎርፍ የጠፉ የቤተሰባቸውን አባላት ፍለጋ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootummaa Hindii keessatti naannoo Asaamitti rooba cimaa robeen hordofee lolaan garmalee ka’e miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Balaa kanaan lubbuun namoota 100 ol darbeera, manneen kumaan lakkaawwaman barbadaa’anii, namoonni dhibbaan lakkaawwaman immoo qe’ee isaanii irraa buqqa’aniiru. Namoonni akka Debiram Panikaa jiran maatiin isaanii balaa kanaan waan jalaa badaniif gadda hamaa keessa jiru.

title: Canada says it will match US tariffs 'dollar for dollar' as trade talks break down
english: Canada has announced plans to implement equal retaliatory tariffs on American goods following the collapse of recent trade negotiations. Prime Minister Mark Carney decided to suspend talks after claiming the U.S. introduced unfair last-minute changes to the proposed agreement. Consequently, new U.S. levies on Canadian products have now taken effect, marking a significant escalation in tensions between the two nations.
amharic: የካናዳ እና የአሜሪካ የንግድ ድርድር በመቋረጡ ምክንያት ካናዳ በአሜሪካ ምርቶች ላይ ተመሳሳይ የሆነ የታሪፍ እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ወሰነች። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ በአሜሪካ የቀረቡት የመጨረሻ ደቂቃ ለውጦች ተቀባይነት የሌላቸው በመሆናቸው ድርድሩን ማቋረጣቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ተከትሎ አሜሪካ በካናዳ ምርቶች ላይ የጣለችው አዲስ የታሪፍ ቀረጥ በይፋ ተግባራዊ ሆኗል።
oromo: Hirmaannaan daldalaa Ameerikaa fi Kaanaadaa gidduutti gaggeeffamaa ture erga gufatee booda, Kaanaadaan gabaa Ameerikaa irraa dhufullee irratti gatii gibiraa wal-qixa ta'e kaa'uuf murteessiteetti. Muummichi ministeeraa Maark Kaarnii akka jedhanitti, Ameerikaan dhimma waliigaltee irratti jijjiirama tasaa waan fideef, mariin daldalaa sun dhaabbachuu qaba jedhaniiru. Kanaan walqabatee, Ameerikaan oomishaalee Kaanaadaa irratti gibira haaraa kan feete yoo ta'u, kunis walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan hammeesse dha.

title: Inundated Philippine communities seek answers over flood control funds
english: Residents in the northern Philippines are frustrated and demanding accountability after severe monsoon flooding devastated their communities. Despite government claims of investing in flood control infrastructure, locals report that these measures failed to protect them. People are now questioning where the allocated funds for these projects went and why the systems remain ineffective.
amharic: በፊሊፒንስ ሰሜናዊ ክፍል የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች በደረሰባቸው ከባድ የጎርፍ አደጋ ምክንያት የተናደዱ ሲሆን መንግስትን ተጠያቂ እያደረጉ ነው። ለጎርፍ መከላከያ ስራዎች በጀት ተመድቦ እንደነበር ቢገለጽም፣ የተገነቡት መዋቅሮች ጥበቃ ማድረግ ባለመቻላቸው ህዝቡ ቅሬታውን እያሰማ ነው። ነዋሪዎቹ ለጎርፍ መከላከያ ፕሮጀክቶች የተመደበው ገንዘብ የት እንደገባ እና ስራዎቹ ለምን ውጤታማ እንዳልሆኑ ማወቅ ይፈልጋሉ።
oromo: Naannoo kaaba Filippiinsitti jiraattonni balaa lolaa cimaan isaan irra gaheen booda mootummaa irraa ibsa barbaadaa jiru. Mootummaan hojiilee ittisa lolaa irratti baajata ramadeera jedhee ibsuus, sirnoonni ijaaraman balaa kana ittisuu waan hin dandeenyeef uummanni aaruu irra jira. Jiraattonni kun maallaqni ittisa lolaaf ramadame eessa akka gahe fi maaliif hojiiwwan kunneen bu'a qabeessa akka hin taane gaaffii kaasaniiru.

title: Palestinian teen shot and killed in West Bank attack, UN responds
english: A 17-year-old Palestinian boy was killed and another individual was left in critical condition following an attack by settlers near Hebron in the occupied West Bank. In response, the United Nations has demanded better protection for Palestinian civilians and called for those responsible to face justice. This incident adds to a troubling increase in violence, with 22 Palestinians already killed in settler-related attacks throughout the current year.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ክፍል ሄብሮን አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመ የሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት የ17 ዓመት ፍልስጤማዊ ታዳጊ ተገደለ፣ ሌላ ግለሰብም ለከፍተኛ ጉዳት ተዳረገ። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የፍልስጤም ሲቪሎች ጥበቃ እንዲደረግላቸው እና ወንጀለኞች ለፍርድ እንዲቀርቡ ጠይቋል። በዚህ ዓመት ብቻ በሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት የተገደሉ የፍልስጤማውያን ቁጥር 22 መድረሱ ሁኔታውን አሳሳቢ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Godina waldhabdee West Bank magaalaa Hebron biratti miidhaa qaqqabeen dargaggeessi umriinsaa waggaa 17 ta'e ajjeefameera, namni biraammoo miidhaa hamaaf saaxilameera. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii lammiileen Falasxiin eegumsa akka argatanfi yakka raawwattoonni seeratti akka dhiyaatan gaafateera. Bara kana keessa qofa haleellaa qe'ee qaban kanaan Falasxiinonni 22 ajjeefamuun isaanii haalli kun akka hammaate agarsiisa.

title: Nigeria and the Sahel: A growing security divide
english: A diplomatic rift is growing between Nigeria and the Sahelian alliance of Burkina Faso, Mali, and Niger, which recently withdrew from the regional bloc ECOWAS. Tensions were highlighted by the brief detention of Nigerian air personnel in Burkina Faso after an emergency landing, reflecting deeper political instability in the region. Experts note that these security challenges are partly linked to historical regional instability, making it difficult for these neighboring nations to cooperate effectively against shared threats like armed militant groups.
amharic: በናይጄሪያ እና በቡርኪና ፋሶ፣ በማሊ እና በኒጀር አሊያንስ መካከል እየሰፋ የመጣው የዲፕሎማሲ ክፍተት በምዕራብ አፍሪካ የጋራ የጸጥታ ጥበቃ ስራዎችን አዳጋች አድርጎታል። በቅርቡ የናይጄሪያ አየር ኃይል አባላት በቡርኪና ፋሶ በአስቸኳይ ማረፊያ ምክንያት መታሰራቸው በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለውን አለመግባባት ያሳያል። የክልሉ የጸጥታ ችግሮች ከሊቢያ የቀውስ ጊዜ ጀምሮ የነበሩ ሲሆን፣ አገራት በትብብር ካልሰሩ በአካባቢው ያሉ ታጣቂ ቡድኖችን መቆጣጠር እንደማይችሉ ባለሙያዎች ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Naijeeriyaafi biyyoota Sahel (Burkiinaa Faasoo, Maalii fi Niijar) gidduutti wal dhabdeen siyaasaa guddachaa jiru nageenya naannichaa irratti dhiibbaa uumaa jira. Haalli kun erga biyyoonni kunneen gamtaa ECOWAS gadi lakkisanii booda kan hammaate yoo ta'u, hidhattoonni qilleensa Naijeeriyaaa tokko xiyyaarri isaanii Burkiinaa Faasoo keessatti dirqamaan erga qubatee booda to'annaa jala oolunsaa wal dhabdee kana caalaatti ifa taasiseera. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, rakkoon nageenyaa kun koraa fi hidhattoota naannichaa to'achuuf biyyoonni kunneen walta'iinsaan hojjechuun isaanii barbaachisaa akka ta'e ibsu.

title: At least 13 Tunisians missing as migrant boat headed for Italy capsizes
english: A boat carrying migrants toward Italy sank off the coast of Tunisia, leaving at least 13 people missing. Only two individuals were rescued from the vessel after it capsized, with one survivor currently in critical condition. This incident highlights the ongoing dangers of Mediterranean crossings and follows growing concerns from human rights groups regarding EU-funded border policies in Tunisia.
amharic: ወደ ጣሊያን ሲጓዝ የነበረ ስደተኞችን የጫነ ጀልባ በቱኒዝያ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ በመስጠሙ ቢያንስ 13 ሰዎች መጥፋታቸው ተሰምቷል። ጀልባዋ ከተገለበጠች በኋላ ሁለት ሰዎች ብቻ በሕይወት የተገኙ ሲሆን አንደኛው በጥብቅ የሕክምና ክትትል ላይ ይገኛል። ይህ አደጋ በሜዲትራኒያን ባህር በኩል የሚደረገው ጉዞ ያለውን ከፍተኛ አደጋ የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ በአውሮፓ ህብረት እና በቱኒዝያ መካከል ያለውን የድንበር ቁጥጥር ስምምነት በተመለከተ የተነሱ ቅሬታዎችንም ዳግም አጉልቶ አሳይቷል።
oromo: Dooniin baqattoota gara Xaaliyaanii geessu tokko qarqara galaana Tunisiyaatti yoo gadagadde, namoonni 13 ol ta'an akka bade himameera. Balaan kun balaa doonii galaana Meditiraaniyaanii keessatti mudatu kan itti fufaa jiru yoo ta'u, walii galtee to'annoo daangaa kan gamtaa Awurooppaa fi Tunisiyaa gidduutti taasifame irratti komiin akka ka'u godheera.

title: US imposes 50% tariffs on $20bn worth of Canadian goods after talks fail
english: The United States has implemented a 50 percent tariff on $20 billion worth of Canadian goods following the collapse of recent trade negotiations in Washington. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney criticized the move and vowed to impose equivalent retaliatory tariffs on American products. While U.S. officials blamed Canada for failing to finalize the agreement, the new taxes will specifically impact electronics, industrial machinery, and dairy imports.
amharic: በዋሽንግተን የተካሄዱ የንግድ ድርድሮች በመክሸፋቸው አሜሪካ በካናዳ ምርቶች ላይ የ50 በመቶ ቀረጥ መጣሏን አስታውቃለች። የካናዳ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ ይህንን ውሳኔ በመቃወም ሀገራቸውም በአሜሪካ ምርቶች ላይ ተመሳሳይ አጸፋዊ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስታውቀዋል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ውድቀቱ የካናዳ ነው ሲሉ የካናዳ መንግስት ደግሞ እርምጃውን በመቃወም አዳዲስ ቀረጦቹ በኤሌክትሮኒክስ፣ በማሽነሪዎች እና በወተት ተዋጽኦዎች ላይ ተጽእኖ እንደሚፈጥሩ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa mariin daldalaa Waashingtonitti taasifamaa ture erga fashaleen booda, meeshaalee Kaanaadaa gatiin isaanii dolaara biliyoona 20 ta'u irratti gibira dhibbeentaa 50 kaa'eera. Ministirri Muummee Kaanaadaa Maark Kaarnii murtee kana balaaleffachuun, Kaanaadaanis meeshaalee Ameerikaa irratti gibira wal-fakkaatu akka keettu dhaadataniiru. Gama mootummaa Ameerikaatiin mariin kun akka hin milkoofneef Kaanaadaa kan komatan yoo ta'u, gibirri haaraan kun immoo meeshaalee elektirooniksii, maashinoota warshaa fi oomishaalee aannanii irratti dhiibbaa uuma.

title: US judge strikes down Trump immigrant visa ban affecting 75 countries
english: A federal judge in Manhattan has overturned a Trump administration policy that halted immigrant visas for people from 75 nations. Judge Jeannette Vargas declared the ban unlawful, noting that the Secretary of State lacked the legal authority to override standard visa processing rules. The ruling follows a lawsuit by advocacy groups challenging the restrictions, which the government had implemented citing concerns about immigrants relying on public resources.
amharic: በማንሃተን የሚገኝ የፌደራል ዳኛ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በ75 አገራት ላይ ጥለውት የነበረውን የስደተኞች ቪዛ እገዳ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ዳኛ ጄኔት ቫርጋስ የእገዳው ውሳኔ ህገ-ወጥ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሩ የቪዛ አሰጣጥ ሂደቱን የመቆጣጠር ህጋዊ ስልጣን እንደሌላቸው አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው የመብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች እገዳው በህግ የተደነገገውን የቪዛ አሰራር የሚፃረር ነው በማለት ባቀረቡት ክስ መሠረት ነው።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa magaalaa Manhattan tokko, bulchiinsi pirezidaant Traamp biyyoota 75 irratti dhorkaa viizaa godhee ture haqeera. Abbaan seerichaa Jeannette Vargas dhorkaan kun seeraan alaa fi aangoo ministeera dhimma alaa kan darbe ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru. Murtii kana kan dabarsan gareewwan mirga namoomaa dhorkaan kun seera baqattummaa biyyattii waliin kan wal-faallessu ta'uu himatanii erga iyyatanii booda dha.

title: UK MP urges government to ban goods produced in West Bank settlements
english: Emily Thornberry, the chair of the UK's Foreign Affairs Committee, is calling on the government to ban goods imported from Israeli settlements in the West Bank. She argues that these settlements and rising violence are destroying the possibility of a two-state solution. Meanwhile, the UK government is planning to take measures against Israel for launching new construction projects that threaten to divide the West Bank.

oromo: Preezidaantiin Koree Dhimma Alaa Paarlaamaa UK, Eemilii Toornberi, mootummaan UK meeshaalee naannoo Waanx Baankiitti iddoo qubannaa Israa'elootaan oomishaman akka hin galchine gaafachaa jirti. Inni kun rakkoo nageenyaa fi qubannaan babal'achaa jiru fala biyya lamaa kan ta'e 'two-state solution' akka fashaleessu isheen ibsiteetti. Mootummaan UK gama isaatiin, ijaarsi haaraan Israa'el Waanx Baankii bakka lamatti qooduuf karoorfatte, nagaa fi tasgabbii naannichaa irratti balaa akka qabu ibsuun tarkaanfii fudhachuuf qophaa'aa jira.

title: Tanker traffic at Saudi Arabia's Yanbu port falls by a third, report says
english: Ship traffic at Saudi Arabia's Yanbu port has dropped significantly following the Houthi blockade in the Red Sea. To bypass this, Saudi Aramco is using a detour through the SUMED pipeline in Egypt to move its oil. Although this strategy maintains exports, it increases transportation costs and causes shipping delays for customers in Asia.
amharic: የየመን ሁቲዎች በቀይ ባህር ላይ ባደረጉት እገዳ ምክንያት በሳውዲ አረቢያ የያንቡ ወደብ የሚደረግ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀንሷል። ይህንን ችግር ለመቅረፍ ሳውዲ አራምኮ የግብፅን የሱመድ የቧንቧ መስመር በመጠቀም ነዳጅን ወደ ውጭ እየላከ ይገኛል። ይህ አማራጭ የወጪ ንግዱ እንዲቀጥል ቢያደርገውም፣ ለኤስያ ገዢዎች የትራንስፖርት ጊዜንና ወጪን ጨምሯል።
oromo: Humni Huutii Yemenii daandii galaana diimaa cufuun isaa, geejjiba dooniiwwan boba'aa buufata Yanbuu kan Saudii Arabaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumeera. Rakkoo kana hiikuuf, kampaniin Aramco boba'aa isaa biyyoota biraatti erguuf gara garaa daandii biyya Masrii fayyadamaa jira. Tarsiimoon kun oomisha biyyattii gabaa biyya alaa akka gahu godhus, gatii geejjibaa fi yeroo gabaa Asiyaa gahuu dheeressera.

title: Peru rescues people trapped by landslides on highway for nearly a week
english: Authorities in Peru have initiated helicopter rescue operations to assist dozens of people stranded for nearly a week. Heavy rains triggered landslides that damaged the Southern Coastal Highway in the Arequipa region, blocking traffic and leaving travelers stuck. Emergency teams are now working to evacuate those affected by the destruction.
amharic: የፔሩ ባለስልጣናት በአሬኪፓ አካባቢ ለስድስት ቀናት ያህል ተጣብቀው የቆዩ ሰዎችን በሄሊኮፕተር የማዳን ስራ ጀምረዋል። በከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት የተከሰተው የመሬት መንሸራተት የደቡባዊ የባህር ዳርቻ አውራ ጎዳናን በማፍረሱ ተሽከርካሪዎች እና መንገደኞች መንገድ ላይ ቀርተው ነበር። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በተጎዱ አካባቢዎች ያሉ ሰዎችን ለማዳን ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Peru namoota naannoo Arequipa keessatti torban tokkoo oliif daandii irratti cufamanii turan helikopteriin oolchuuf sochiilee jalqabeera. Rooba cimaan lafti akka sigidduu fi daandiin guddaan gammoojjii kibbaa akka cufamu gochuun, konkolaattotaa fi namoota hedduu daandii irratti akka hafan godheera. Gareewwan hatattamaa namoota miidhaan irra ga'e kana bakka rakkoo irraa baasuuf hojjetaa jiru.

title: Palestinian-British girl, 6, dies days after family drowned off UK coast
english: A six-year-old Palestinian-British girl has passed away in the hospital following a tragic drowning incident at a beach in Sussex, UK. Her parents and teenage sister had already lost their lives at the scene earlier this week during a family trip amid a summer heatwave. Local authorities are investigating the event as a tragic accident with no signs of external involvement.
amharic: በእንግሊዝ ሰሴክስ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ በተፈጠረ አሳዛኝ የመስጠም አደጋ የስድስት ዓመቷ የፍልስጤም-ብሪቲሽ ህጻን በሆስፒታል ህክምናዋን ስትከታተል ቆይታ ህይወቷ አልፏል። የህጻኗ ወላጆች እና የአስራ አራት ዓመት እህቷ ቀደም ብለው በዚሁ አደጋ ህይወታቸው ማለፉ ይታወሳል። የሀገሪቱ ፖሊስ አደጋው የደረሰው በከፍተኛ ሙቀት ወቅት ቤተሰቡ ለጉብኝት በሄዱበት ወቅት እንደሆነ ገልጾ፣ በምንም አይነት ወንጀል የተፈጠረ ሳይሆን ድንገተኛ አደጋ እንደሆነ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mucaan waggaa ja'aa kan taate dubartiin lammii Palastine fi Biriteen taate tokko, qarqara galaana Sussex, UK irratti mudateen erga bishaan keessatti liqimfamtee booda hospitaala keessatti lubbuun ishee darbeera. Obboleettiin ishee waggaa kudha afurii fi warri ishee kanaan dura bakka sanaatti du'uu isaanii gabaasni ni ibsa. Poolisiin naannichaa akka jedhetti, lammiileen kunneen ho'a qilleensaa cimaa sana keessa bakka sanatti boqonnaa fudhachuuf kan dhaqan yoo ta'u, duuti kun balaa tasaa malee kan biraa akka hin jirre ibseera.

title: 'We have more work to do', says Canada negotiator as US trade deadline looms
english: Canadian officials are working intensely in Washington to finalize a trade agreement with the US before a critical midnight deadline. Negotiators are aiming to avoid new tariffs, while discussing potential concessions such as opening the Canadian dairy market and reducing levies on steel and automobiles. Prime Minister Justin Trudeau's government faces internal pressure to ensure the deal remains fair for Canadian industries as talks continue down to the wire.
amharic: የካናዳ ተወካዮች ከአሜሪካ ጋር የንግድ ስምምነት ለመፈራረም በዋሽንግተን ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። የሁለቱ ሀገራት ድርድር የአሜሪካን የጉምሩክ ቀረጥ ለማስቀረት ያለመ ሲሆን፣ በካናዳ የወተት ምርቶች ገበያ እና በብረታ ብረት ላይ የሚጣሉ ቀረጦችን የሚመለከቱ ውይይቶች እየተካሄዱ ነው። የካናዳ መንግስት ስምምነቱ ለሀገሪቱ ኢንዱስትሪዎች ጠቃሚ እንዲሆን ግፊት ቢኖርበትም፣ የመጨረሻ ሰዓት ላይ የሚደረገው ድርድር አሁንም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Kaanaadaa waliigaltee daldalaa Ameerikaa waliin qaban xumuruuf magaalaa Waashingitanitti carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru. Mariin kun gibira daldalaa haaraa Ameerikaa irraa dhufu hambisuuf kan karoorfame yoo ta'u, qonnaa aannanii fi oomisha sibiilaa irratti jijjiirama gochuuf marii irra jiru. Mootummaan Kaanaadaa waliigaltee kana biyya isaaniitiif faayidaa qabeessa taasisuuf dhiibbaa keessoo fi alaa jiru dandamachaa marii isaanii itti fufaniiru.

title: TikTok to pay $400m to US in one of largest child privacy settlements
english: TikTok has agreed to a $400 million settlement with the U.S. government to resolve a lawsuit regarding the illegal collection of data from children under 13. The case alleged that the platform violated federal privacy laws by failing to secure parental consent for its younger users. As part of the agreement, the company is required to make payments to the Department of Justice and continue improving its safety practices for minors.
amharic: ቲክቶክ ከ13 ዓመት በታች የሆኑ ህጻናትን መረጃ ያለ ህጋዊ ፈቃድ በመሰብሰብ ክስ እንደቀረበበት በመግለጽ ለዩናይትድ ስቴትስ መንግስት 400 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ለመክፈል ተስማምቷል። ይህ ስምምነት ኩባንያው የህጻናትን ግላዊነት የሚጠብቁ የፌዴራል ህጎችን ባለማክበሩ የተደረገ ነው። እንደ ስምምነቱ ከሆነ ቲክቶክ ክፍያውን ከመፈጸም በተጨማሪ ለታዳጊ ተጠቃሚዎቹ የሚሰጠውን የደህንነት ጥበቃ ማሻሻል ይጠበቅበታል።
oromo: Tiik-tok (TikTok) ijoollee waggaa 13 gadi ta'an irraa odeeffannoo seeraan ala walitti qabuun himatamee, mootummaa Yuunaayitid Isteetsiif qarshii miiliyoona 400 kaffaluuf walii galeera. Himannaan kun kan ka'e, dhaabbatichi seera eegumsa icitii ijoollee cabsee hayyama warra ijoolleetiin alatti odeeffannoo sassaabuun isaa ibsamee ture. Walii galtee kanaan, dhaabbatichi kaffaltii kana raawwachuun cinaatti, eegumsa nageenyaa fayyadamtoota isaa xixiqqoo irratti fooyyessa gochuuf dirqameera.

title: Iranian president says time to end war with US from ‘position of strength’
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has advocated for concluding the ongoing conflict with the United States, asserting that Iran is currently in a position of strength. While the president seeks to defend recent diplomatic efforts from domestic critics, the Iranian military continues to issue warnings of a severe response to any potential threats. Meanwhile, international diplomatic efforts are underway, with Oman mediating discussions to address shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz and encourage a resumption of negotiations.
amharic: የኢራን ፕሬዚዳንት መስኡድ ፔዘሽኪያን አገራቸው በኃይል ደረጃ ላይ እንደምትገኝ በመግለጽ ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያለውን ግጭት በአሁኑ ወቅት ማቆም እንደሚገባ ተናግረዋል። ፕሬዚዳንቱ የቅርብ ጊዜ የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረቶችን ከአገር ውስጥ ተቺዎች ቢከላከሉም፣ የኢራን ወታደራዊ አመራሮች ግን በማንኛውም ስጋት ላይ ከፍተኛ አጸፋ እንደሚሰጡ እያስጠነቀቁ ይገኛሉ። በሌላ በኩል ኦማን በሆርሙዝ ባህር ወሽመጥ ላይ የተፈጠረውን የትራፊክ መስተጓጎል ለመፍታት እና ድርድሩን ለማስቀጠል መካከለኛ ሆና እየሰራች ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeeshkiyaan, biyyi isaanii bakka humnaa irra jirti jechuun waraana Yuuniited Isteetsii waliin jiru xumuruun akka barbaachisu ibsaniiru. Pirezidaantichi yaaliiwwan dippiloomaasii dhiyootti godhaman mormitoota biyya keessaa irraa ittisuuf yaalaniyyu, raayyaan ittisa biyyattii garuu sodaachisa kamiyyuu irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf qophii ta'uu akeekkachiisaa jiru. Gammachuu kanaan, biyyi Omaan rakkoo geejjiba galaanaa lafa dhiphoo Hormuz irratti mudate furuufi mariin akka itti fufuuf giddu galeessummaa gochaa jirti.

title: California lawmaker overcomes pro-Israel spending to win special election
english: Progressive candidate Aisha Wahab has won a special election in California, securing her position as the first Afghan American in Congress. She achieved this victory despite significant campaign spending against her by pro-Israel interest groups. Wahab, who has previously called for an end to the war in Gaza, will represent the 14th district for the remainder of the current term.
amharic: ተራማጅ እጩ አይሻ ዋሃብ በካሊፎርኒያ በተካሄደ ልዩ ምርጫ በማሸነፍ በአሜሪካ ኮንግረስ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የተመረጡ አፍጋኒስታናዊ አሜሪካዊ ሆነዋል። የእስራኤል ደጋፊ ቡድኖች በእርሷ ላይ ከፍተኛ ገንዘብ አውጥተው ዘመቻ ቢያደርጉም ውጤቱን መቀልበስ አልቻሉም። የጋዛን ጦርነት በመቃወም የምትታወቀው ዋሃብ፣ የቀድሞውን የኮንግረስ አባል ኤሪክ ስዋልዌልን በመተካት የ14ኛውን ዲስትሪክት ወክለው ይሰራሉ።
oromo: Duula filannoo addaa Kaaliifoorniyaa keessatti, kaadhimamtuun dura-deemtuu Aisha Wahab injifannoo argachuun namtittii Afgaan-Ameerikaa jalqabaa gara Koongirasii biyyattii seenuu taateetti. Gareewwan Israa'el deggaran maallaqa hedduu baasuun duula ishee irratti geggeessaniyyuu injifannoo kana galmeessisuu dandeesseetti. Wahab, kan waraana Gaazaatiin mormitu, bakka buutuun durii Eric Swalwell bakka buutee hanga dhuma bara hojii isaatti kutaa 14ffaa bakka buutee akka tajaajiltu eegama.

title: Guyana’s Rodrigues Birkett leads informal poll in race to be next UN leader
english: Guyanese Ambassador Carolyn Rodrigues Birkett has taken the lead in the second informal poll to select the next UN Secretary-General. She outperformed seven other candidates, including the previous frontrunner, as the Security Council works to find a successor for Antonio Guterres before his term ends in December. These non-binding votes are helping the council narrow down the field of applicants before a formal recommendation is finalized.
amharic: የጉያናው አምባሳደር ካሮሊን ሮድሪገስ ቢርኬት፣ ቀጣዩ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ዋና ጸሐፊ ለመሆን በሚደረገው መደበኛ ያልሆነ የምርጫ ሂደት ግንባር ቀደም ሆነዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት የአንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝን የስራ ዘመን ማብቂያ ተከትሎ አዲስ መሪ ለመምረጥ በሚያደርገው ጥረት፣ እሳቸው ከሌሎች ሰባት እጩዎች የተሻለ ድጋፍ አግኝተዋል። እነዚህ የምርጫ ሂደቶች የመጨረሻ ውሳኔ ከመሰጠቱ በፊት እጩዎችን ቁጥር ለመቀነስ የሚረዱ ናቸው።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Guyyaanaa Kaaroliin Rodriges Birkeet, bakka bu'aa dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniitiif itti aanee filamuuf adeemsa filannoo hin-seera-qabeessa keessatti dursaa jiru. Mana maree naga eegumsaa keessatti akkaataa filannoo kanatti fayyadamuun, yeroon Antooniyoo Guuteereez dhuma waggaa kanaa waan xumuramuuf, bakka bu'aa isaanii barbaaduuf carraaqqii taasifamaa jiru. Filannoon kun hirmaattota filannoo gidduutti deggarsa jiru madaaluufi namoota gita kanaaf dorgoman hir'isuuf kan gargaaruudha.
